360-degree vision.description: When vision is 360 degrees chance to be Surprised is reduced by 100%.

360-degree Vision.description: When vision is 360 degrees chance to be Surprised is reduced by 100%.

360-Degree Vision.description: When vision is 360 degrees chance to be Surprised is reduced by 100%.

Absorbent Skin.description: Takes twice the normal amount of time before this creature needs to be submerged in water.

Absorptive Skin.description: The creature`s skin absorbs nutrients doing acid damage to exposed flesh, dissolving it.

Organic Absorption.description: Can absorb any biologival material and convert it to the creature`s form. First contact causes adherence. Strength save required to break free once per 10 seconds, -5% per foot of material covering/contacting the being. Every minute 1 half cubic foot of biological is converted (cannot absorb armor, etc.).

Absorption/Conversion.description: Can absorb any biologival material and convert it to the creature`s form. First contact causes adherence. Strength save required to break free once per 10 seconds, -5% per foot of material covering/contacting the being. Every minute 1 half cubic foot of biological is converted (cannot absorb armor, etc.).

Absorption/Conversion(Animal).description: Can absorb any animal material and convert it to the creature`s form. First contact causes adherence. Strength save required to break free once per 10 seconds, -5% per foot of animal material covering/contacting the being. Every minute 1 half cubic foot of animal is converted to plant matter (cannot absorb armor, etc.).

Absorption Conversion(Plant/Animal).description: Can absorb any plant or animal material and convert it to the creature`s form. First contact causes adherence. Strength save required to break free once per 10 seconds, -5% per foot of plant material covering/contacting the being. Every minute 1 half cubic foot of animal/plant is converted to plant matter (cannot absorb armor, etc.).

Absorption/Conversion(Plant).description: Can absorb any plant material and convert it to the plant`s form (1 cubic inch per hour), thus healing itself at a rate of 1 Endurance per hour.

Absorption(Self).description: The plant can merge with other plants of it`s type, i.e. grow together and become one plant.

Accelerated Regeneration.description: Accelerated Regeneration: +4 points per 10 seconds to all wounds; double this regeneration rate if resting.

Acid.description: Secretes a concecrated acid doing damge to anything it touches.

Acid Blood.description: The blood of the creature is acidic and lowers the object strength of objects that it touches, as well as damage to flesh (but not the creature itself). This will apply to any weapons which cut or pierce the creature.

Acid Regeneration.description: All acid damage to the creature is absorbed and heals all wounds on a 1 for 1 for basis.

Acid Sap.description: The plant has a form of sap that is corrosive (doing 1d4 points per hour to all fleshy substances). It may also have stems or pitchers that can release and store this sap. These pitchers will often close automatically when touched or stroked.

Acid Sap(Magical).description: Can release extremely corrosive sap causing 1d10 per 10 seconds to all objects that contact it. Can only release one dose per cubic foot of plant per hour.

Acid Skin.description: The skin of the creature is acidic and lowers the object strength of objects that touch it, as well as damaging flesh (but not the creature itself). This will apply to any objects which touch the creature.

Acid Spit/Bite.description: The creature can either spit acid a concentrated stream, or release acid as part of a bite.

Acid Spit.description: The creature can spit acid in a concentrated stream.

Acid Spitting.description: The creature can spit acid in a concentrated stream.

Acid Spit Glob.description: The creature can spit a glob of concentrated acid.

Acid Spores.description: The plant releases spores which are acid and do acid damage to living beings they contact.

Acid Touch.description: A body area or contact point secretes acid, causing damage through armor (magic armor gets a save).

Additional Limbs.description: The creature can have additional limbs (as listed on its body chart), and these count as limb areas identical to the rest of the body for Endurance. Each limb has 5 seconds of action per combat round, even if the creature is ambidextrous.

Additional Limb Pair(Arms).description: An additional pair of shoulders, arms, forearms and hands. All are considered off-handed.

Additional Limb Pair(Legs).description: An additional pair of thighs, shins and feet, removing penalty modifiers for beings normally without legs and increasing speed by 25% for those who already possess one pair of legs.

Air Bladder.description: A large bladder within or on the body that stores air for extended periods. Allows the lungs to take in oxygen when none is available from the environment.

Air Bladder(Magical).description: A large bladder within or on the body that stores air for very long periods, even multiplying available air through magical means. The bladder is considered invulnerable to pressure changes.

Air Jets.description: The ability to condense air and eject it at high speed for short bursts of fast propulsion. Takes 10 minutes to replenish and reheat the air, for additional bursts.

Air Jets(Magical).description: The ability to magically condense air and eject it at high speed and volume in a continuous fashion for fast propulsion.

Air Elemental Form.description: Air Elemental Form(Creature can transform into an Air Elemental. With all powers and abilities at a level equal to Class Title x2. Requires a source of Air. Should be readily around.)

Agility.description: Has an increased Agility for a creature of it`s type.

Always Hit(Melee).description: The being or creature never misses a melee attack, even with a roll of 1. A to hit roll is used (if needed) for other reasons, called shot, extra double damage (Sharpness, etc.).

Always Hit(Missile).description: The being or creature never misses a missile attack, even with a roll of 1. A to hit roll is used (if needed) for other reasons, called shot, extra double damage (Sharpness, etc.).

Ambidextrous.description: The creature has 10 seconds of time and no penalties in both primary manipulator limbs.

Animal Friendship.description: Animal Friendship(Animals will not willing attack this creature. Controlled animals get a new CR to avoid attacking).

Antennae.description: Antennae(2 tendril/stalks x1/10th END that allow hearing and smell. Lost of antennae loses those senses).

Antlers.description: Antlers: Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat.

Appearance.description: Has an increased Appearance for a creature of it`s type.

Aura.description: Has an increased Aura for a creature of it`s type.

Aura Container.description: The creature has separate container for Aura, which can be used to hold Aura points taken from other beings or items without causing the being to burst into flames. This extra Aura will count towards the beings Aura rating for purposes of skills, saves and spells.

Aura Reservoir.description: The creature has separate container for Aura, which can be used to hold Aura points taken from other beings or items without causing the being to burst into flames. This extra Aura will count towards the beings Aura rating for purposes of skills, saves and spells.

Aura Sense.description: The creature has the ability to sense the Aura rating of other creatures, Aura magics, as well as active spells.

Balancing Tail.description: Balancing Tail(+10% to movement Agility Saves).

Banshee Howl.description: This undead has the ability to howl so horrendously, that all listeners within hearing range (generally 1 mile for open areas) must make a Control Resistance or die of terror. Beings of 15 or higher Will Force are immune to this effect.

Banshee Wail.description: At will, (once per 10 seconds) all listeners in hearing range (generally 1 mile for open areas) must make a Control Resistance or suffer a form of Insanity. Beings of 15 or higher Will Force are immune to this effect.

Barbed Thorns.description: Does damage to all areas that contact the thorny surface (+1 per die). 1d6+2 thorns break off in the flesh of the victim and do 1 point of damage each when removed.

Barbed Tail.description: The creature has a tail which ends in a spike that is barbed. The barb may break off and lodge itself in the wound.

Bark(Irritant).description: Causes a rash within 24 hours of contact of a fleshy beings skin. Rash lasts 3d4 days and causes 1 point of damage per day if itched. Itching must be resisted with Will Force save or some form of topical lotion.

Bark(Parasitic).description: A Disease Resistance is required or the being or animal is infected with a parasitic agent.

Bark(Razor).description: Tiny surfaces as sharp do 1d6+2 to all areas that contact them.

Bark(Sharp).description: Sharpened bark that causes 1-3 damage to areas contacting it.

Bark(Venomous).description: Venom(secretes or releases a poison on its bark).

Beak.description: Beak: Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat.

Beam(Death).description: A death ray that travels 10 feet per level of the creature. Any being struck must make a Magic Resistance or die instantly.

Beam(Fire).description: A heat ray that travels 10 feet per level of the creature. Any being struck must make a Magic Resistance or take heat damage.

Beam(Paralysis).description: Shoots a beam of paralysis that goes 10 feet per level of the creature. Any being struck must make a Magic Resistance or be paralyzed for 10 seconds per creature level.

Beam(Sleep).description: A sleep ray that travels 10 feet per level of the creature. Any being struck with less than 15 Will Force must make a Control Resistance or fall asleep for 1 minute per level of the creature.

Berserking.description: The creature gains the Berserking skill.

Bioluminescence.description: The organic ability to produce a low light emanating directly from the body or extended limb.

Blood Conversion.description: The creature can convert blood into Endurance. Some versions of this also add a Mystical Drain to this effect. Endurance cannot exceed double starting value.

Blood Siphon.description: Creature can siphon blood from its victim every 5 seconds via some physical means, generally the mouth (subtract 1d4 Endurance from target every 5 seconds).

Blowhole.description: Allows the animal to draw air and expel waste gases from the hole, while keeping water out. It increases swimming skill chance by 20%.

Bonding.description: The creature has Telepathy (as the spell) with lovers and friends and Improved Telepathy (as the spell) with the its life mate.

Brain.description: A creature that normally wouldn`t have a brain, now does in  one of it`s vital regions, becoming self aware.

Brain Case.description: A creature that normally wouldn`t have a brain, now does in  one of it`s vital regions, becoming self aware.

Breathless.description: Breathless(No need to breathe to remain living).

Breath Attack(Acid).description: The creature can breathe acid in a cone like shape no longer than twice the creature`s height/length.

Breath Attack(Aura Fire).description: The creature can breathe aura fire in a cone like shape no longer than twice the creature`s height/length.

Breath Attack(Death).description: The creature can breathe forth the very power of death as a cone-shaped cloud no longer than twice the creature’s length. All beings caught in this cloud must make a Will Force save at half or be instantly slain. Only a being level 15 or higher and sustained by negative life force can have this ability.

Breath Attack(Fire).description: The creature can breathe fire in a cone like shape no longer than twice the creature`s height/length.

Breath Attack(Frost).description: The creature can breathe frost in a cone like shape no longer than twice the creature`s height/length.

Breath Attack(Lightning).description: The creature can breathe electricity in a cone like shape no longer than twice the creature`s height/length.

Breath Attack(Electricity).description: The creature can breathe electricity in a cone like shape no longer than twice the creature`s height/length.

Breath Attack(Poison).description: The creature can breathe a gaseous venom in a cone like shape no longer than three times the creature`s height/length, and as wide as the creature.

Breath Attack(Poison Gas).description: The creature can breathe a gaseous venom in a cone like shape no longer than three times the creature`s height/length, and as wide as the creature.

Breath Attack(Strong Bolt).description: Changes the shape and strength of a breath attack (fire, frost, etc), to This attack extends in a line directly from the mouth, traveling for 2` per 20 Endurance of the creature with a 200` maximum. The width of the bolt is 6“ inches across and strikes only one body area on most human sized targets. This attack can only be attempted 3 times per day. Normal attack roll is used to strike opponents. However, opponents directly in line of the bolt all must save as the bolt will extend through each opponent until all damage has been absorbed or the maximum length has been reached.

Breath Attack(Strong Cone).description: Changes the shape and strength of a breath attack (fire, frost, etc), to a cone 2` long per 10 Endurance of the creature with a 200` maximum length. The base is 1/4 width of the length with a maximum of 50`. The cone can target a humanoid with an attack rolled on the standard attack chart. A miss indicateds the cone has failed to hit the being and the edge of the cone is placed next to the being. An off center hit indicates that the cone has struck the individual but that one edge of the cone is placed directly on the individual. A dead center hit places the cone directly on the targeted being. Alternately the cone can be placed without targeting an individual. In these cases the cone is placed with a 10 or better on a d20 after adding all missile modifiers. A miss indicates the cone is off in placement by 1d6 per 5` of the width of the base.

Breath: Strong Cone(Aura).description: The creature can breathe aura fire in a cone 2` long per 10 Endurance of the creature with a 200` maximum length. The base is 1/4 width of the length with a maximum of 50`. The cone can target a humanoid with an attack rolled on the standard attack chart. A miss indicateds the cone has failed to hit the being and the edge of the cone is placed next to the being. An off center hit indicates that the cone has struck the individual but that one edge of the cone is placed directly on the individual. A dead center hit places the cone directly on the targeted being. Alternately the cone can be placed without targeting an individual. In these cases the cone is placed with a 10 or better on a d20 after adding all missile modifiers. A miss indicates the cone is off in placement by 1d6 per 5` of the width of the base.

Breath: Strong Cone(Cold).description: The creature can breathe frost in a cone 2` long per 10 Endurance of the creature with a 200` maximum length. The base is 1/4 width of the length with a maximum of 50`. The cone can target a humanoid with an attack rolled on the standard attack chart. A miss indicateds the cone has failed to hit the being and the edge of the cone is placed next to the being. An off center hit indicates that the cone has struck the individual but that one edge of the cone is placed directly on the individual. A dead center hit places the cone directly on the targeted being. Alternately the cone can be placed without targeting an individual. In these cases the cone is placed with a 10 or better on a d20 after adding all missile modifiers. A miss indicates the cone is off in placement by 1d6 per 5` of the width of the base.

Breath: Strong Cone(Fire).description: The creature can breathe fire in a cone 2` long per 10 Endurance of the creature with a 200` maximum length. The base is 1/4 width of the length with a maximum of 50`. The cone can target a humanoid with an attack rolled on the standard attack chart. A miss indicateds the cone has failed to hit the being and the edge of the cone is placed next to the being. An off center hit indicates that the cone has struck the individual but that one edge of the cone is placed directly on the individual. A dead center hit places the cone directly on the targeted being. Alternately the cone can be placed without targeting an individual. In these cases the cone is placed with a 10 or better on a d20 after adding all missile modifiers. A miss indicates the cone is off in placement by 1d6 per 5` of the width of the base.

Breath Attack(Strong Gas Cloud).description: Changes the shape and strength of a breath attack (fire, frost, etc), to an oval cloud 2` long and 1` wide (and deep) per 10 Endurance of the creature with a 200` by 100` by 100` maximum cloud size. The cloud may only be created 3 times per day. Roll of 10 or better (plus missile modifier) on a d20 indicates correct placement. Otherwise cloud is off by 1d6 feet per 5` of the cloud; placement is off in the direction indicated by a d12.

Breath Attack(Strong Spit Glob).description: Changes the shape and strength of a breath attack (fire, frost, etc), to a glob of spit, fired from the creature`s mouth. Can travel up to 3` per 20 Endurance of the creature with a 300` maximum.The glob is about a 2` to 4` in average diameter and will strike one humanoid body region and 2 random adjacent ones on a normal sized target. The normal attack chart is used to strike opponents. Range is considered short until 1/2 of the maximum distance and medium thereafter. This attack can be used up to 3 times in a single day.

Breath Attack(Weak Bolt).description: Changes the shape and strength of a breath attack (fire, frost, etc), to This attack extends in a line directly from the mouth, traveling for 2` per 20 Endurance of the creature with a 100` maximum. The width of the bolt is only a few inches across and strikes only one body area on most human sized targets.  This attack can only be attempted 3 times per day. Normal attack roll is used to strike opponents.

Breath Attack(Weak Cone).description: Changes the shape and strength of a breath attack (fire, frost, etc), to a cone 2` long per 20 Endurance of the creature with a 100` maximum length. The base is 1/4 width of the length with a maximum of 25`. The cone can target a humanoid with an attack rolled on the standard attack chart. A miss indicateds the cone has failed to hit the being and the edge of the cone is placed next to the being. An off center hit indicates that the cone has struck the individual but that one edge of the cone is placed directly on the individual. A dead center hit places the cone directly on the targeted being. Alternately the cone can be placed without targeting an individual. In these cases the cone is placed with a 10 or better on a d20 after adding all missile modifiers. A miss indicates the cone is off in placement by 1d4 per 5` of the width of the base.

Breath Attack(Weak Gas Cloud).description: Changes the shape of a breath attack (fire, frost, etc), to an oval cloud 2` long and 1` wide (and deep) per 20 Endurance of the creature with a 100` by 50` by 50` maximum cloud size. The cloud may only be created 3 times per day. Roll of 10 or better (plus missile modifier) on a d20 indicates correct placement. Otherwise cloud is off by 1d4 feet per 5` of the cloud; placement is off in the direction indicated by a d12.

Breath Attack(Weak Spit Glob).description: Changes the shape and strength of a breath attack (fire, frost, etc), to a glob of spit, fired from the creature`s mouth. Can travel up to 3` per 20 Endurance of the creature with a 150` maximum.The glob is about a 6“ to 1`6“ in average diameter and will strike one humanoid body region on a normal sized target. The normal attack chart is used to strike opponents. Range is considered short until 1/2 of the maximum distance and medium thereafter. This attack can be used up to 3 times in a single day.

Breath Weapon(Magical Heat/Oil).description: Shoots a pool of hot magical oil outward, it can either strike someone causing them to make a Magic Resistance or take heat damage to 1d4 adjacent areas or it can be squirted into a pool about 10 feet in diameter that cause all who are standing in it or who enter it to make half Agility Saves to stay standing. They can only make this attack once per 30 seconds.)

Breath Weapon(Magical Heat/Steam).description: Blasts a cone of steam 10 wide and 20 feet long, no more than once per 30 seconds, all within the cone must make a Magic Resistance or take magical heat/steam damage.)

Breath Weapon(Magical Heat(Steam).description: Blasts a cone of steam 10 wide and 20 feet long, no more than once per 30 seconds, all within the cone must make a Magic Resistance or take magical heat/steam damage.)

Breathing Skin.description: Breathes through its skin, instead of lungs or gills.

Burning Skin.description: Any fire damage caused by touching the skin of this creature is increased by 1 die.

Call Twilight.description: Call Twilight(Remove some sunlight in a 50` sq. foot area per 4 WIL, to a height of 40`. Creates a shadowy gray landscape. Activation requires a WIL Save. Lasts 30 minutes per WIL. Has no effect on other light sources.)

Camouflage Leaves.description: Leaves that can camouflage the plant, making it require a perception check to be seen.

Cellular Division.description: The organism is composed of visible cells. Each cell counts as a body region. Cells can divide under stress, and when they do, Endurance is divided equally between them.

Chaos Voice.description: When the creature laughs or speaks for 5 seconds all who hear must make a Magic Resistance or mistake friend for foe. This lasts 10-30 seconds. Also, each action made while the being laughs or speaks requires an Intelligence Save or the action is at -10%/-2 because of confusion.

Chameleon Fur.description: The creature has fur which will change to the color of the environment, gaining +20% Blend, +10% Move Unseen.

Chameleon Skin.description: The creature has a skin which will change to the color of the environment, gaining +20% Blend, +10% Move Unseen.

Changeling Form.description: Changeling Form(Can change into another humanoid form within 1.5 feet of their height x2 day. Disguise skill success allows copying of another humanoid`s form. Mimic allows copying of their voice.)

Chaos Skin.description: The skin of the creature has a magical chaos effect and lowers the object strength of objects that touch it, as well as damaging flesh (but not the creature itself). This will apply to any objects which touch the creature.

Chemical Conversion.description: A form of chemical or a compound (blood, sulfur, salt, etc.) can be converted by the plant directly into energy to replace photosynthesis. To a degree all plants absorb some nutrients through their roots but these plants can survive completely on chemicals.

Chill.description: Creature can draw heat from beings. Does 1d4 damage per cubic foot of creature to beings contacting the creature and needs 1 hour to recharge per 1d4 done.

Chill(Plant).description: Plant can draw heat from beings. Does 1d4 damage per cubic foot of plant to beings contacting the plant and needs 1 hour to recharge per 1d4 done.

Chill Touch.description: A body area or contact point steals heat from other beings, causing damage through armor (magic armor gets a save).

Clawed Nails.description: Clawed Nails: Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat.

Claws.description: Claws: Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat.

Claws(Large).description: Large Claws: Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat.

Claws(Medium).description: Claws: Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat.

Claws(Small).description: Small Claws: Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat.

Climbing.description: Climbing: the creature has claws, hooks or limbs which are ideal for climbing (+10% Climb).

Climb.description: Climbing: the creature has claws, hooks or limbs which are ideal for climbing (+10% Climb).

Cloud Emitter.description: This creature emits an obscuring cloud, +20% to Surprise Attack, Move Unseen. Creature is -2 to be hit.

Coalesced Form.description: This ability allows a being to recreate its Physical form, including all non-magical clothing and items on the body at the time of death, and all non-magical physical characteristics. The being must have a Phaseable or Non-Corporeal form, and at one time have had a Physical form. With this ability, the being is considered to be temporarily inhabiting the body. After each hour of remaining in the body, the being loses 1 Will Force point. If the physical body is destroyed, the being simply phases out (gaining back all lost Will Force) and may recreate its physical form in the future.

Cold Regeneration.description: All cold/frost damage to the creature is absorbed and heals all wounds on a 1 for 1 for basis.

Combat Emotion.description: +10% to combat skills while affected by one emotion.

Compound Eyes.description: Vision is extended in a hemispherical pattern but clarity is reduced. -1 melee/-2 missile attack but chance to be surprised is reduced by 50%.

Compulsion.description: Must make a Will Force save to avoid a compulstion.

Confusion Gaze.description: All who meet the gaze of the creature must make a Control Resistance or wander aimlessly for 1d4+1 minutes.

Constriction.description: Constricts based on special senses. Does damage based on type of constricting plant fiber and number. Vines do 1d4+1 per 10 seconds per vine, branches do 2d6+2 per 10 seconds, trunks do 3d6+3 per 10 seconds.

Constriction Grapple.description: Constriction Grapple(Grapple:+20% to all saves/contests, pinned opponents take 4d4 constriction per 5 sec).

Construct Mind.description: Construct Mind(Has a mind that is not of flesh but magical. If the mind is destroyed then the creature dies. Gains immunity to Fear, Hold, and Sleep.)

Construct Form.description: Construct Form(Body made of a normal material but affected magically so that it can flex, heal, and otherwise act as flesh when needed. Hide is gained depending on material and Endurance: Clay: 1 per 6 End., Wood: 1 per 5, Stone: 1 per 4, Metal 1 per 3. Attacks are gained based on type, see combat, Clay and Wood can wear flexible and semi-flexible armor. Stone and metal can only wear flexible. Beings with the ability Construct Form gain the following immunities: Disease, Fatigue, Frost Hardened, Greater Poison, Lesser Transformation of Form, and Shock. Beings with this ability must also take the following disabilities: Cannot Swim (Clay, Metal, Stone only), Infertile, No Intake, No Sense of Smell, and No Sense of Taste.)

Control Drain.description: Added to any attribute drain ability, but if the victim`s attribute goes below zero, the victim is transformed into a creature of similar type under the control of the creature that drained it.

Control Gaze.description: When the creature gazes at a victim, the victim must make a Control Resistance or fall under the effects of the spell Control Humanoid as long as the victim is within sight of the creature.

Control Touch.description: When the creature touches a victim, the victim must make a Control Resistance or fall under the effects of the spell Control Humanoid as long as the victim is within sight of the creature.

Control Voice.description: When a victim hears the voice of the creature, the victim must make a Control Resistance or fall under the effects of the spell Control Humanoid as long as the victim can hear the voice.

Corporeal Possession.description: Beings with the disability Detached Psyche may use this ability to possess physical forms bereft of a Spirit and Soul. To initiate possession, a Control Resistance must be made; if it is failed, the being may never possess that form at any time. Once in possession of a form, the Detached Psyche can manipulate and control it, with a penalty of -1 or -5% to all physical actions and physical effects for the first 30 minutes (minus 1 minute per Will Force). Duration and cost of possession varies with the type of form possessed: 1) Mindless Husk: This is the physical body of a being that has died, but whose Mind or Spirit still remain within the body due to Mental Slavery or a Ritual. A Detached Psyche may possess this form for 1 week per Will Force point, and after each week must make a Control Resistance (with a cumulative -5% modifier for each week) or be permanently rejected. 2) Humanoid Corpse: This is the physical body of a being that has died, losing its Mind, Spirit and Soul. When the Detached Psyche initiates possession of a corpse, it is -5% to its Control Resistance for each hour the being has been dead. A Detached Psyche may possess this form for 1 day per natural Will Force point, and after each day must make a Control Resistance (with a cumulative -5% modifier for each day) or be permanently rejected. 3) Animal Corpse: When the Detached Psyche initiates possession of an animal corpse, it is -5% to its Control Resistance for each 10 minutes the animal has been dead. A Detached Psyche may possess this form for 10 minutes per Will Force point, and after each 10 minutes must make a Control Resistance (with a cumulative -5% modifier for each 10 minutes) or be permanently rejected.

Dance Language.description: The creature can communicate in complex ways through body movement and without having to speak.

Dark Fur.description: +10% to Move Unseen in shadows or low light

Dark Fur/Markings.description: +10% to Move Unseen in shadows or low light

Dark Markings.description: +10% to Move Unseen in shadows or low light

Darts.description: Darts: Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat.

Dead Changeling Form.description: Being can change into another humanoid form twice per day if it has touched the targeted dead being it wants to appear as. Applying the racial modifiers for that race, against the Changeling`s original values changes physical attributes and Appearance accordingly. The Disguise skill allows the Changeling to assume the form of a particular individual of that race. The Mimic skill allows the Changeling to speak as a particular individual.

Death Drain.description: Added to any attribute drain ability, but if the victim`s attribute goes below zero, the victim dies and the drain ability is permanent, no matter what form the victim takes in the future (resurrected, undead, etc.).

Death Gaze.description: When a living being sees the gaze of this creature, they must make a Control Resistance or suffer a heart attack: 6d6 damage to the upper torso. No actions may be taken for 1d4 minutes. The victim must make a Vitality save or lose 1 Vitality rating permanently.

Death Limb Regeneration.description: Regenerates 1 point per minute to limbs if in contact with a corpse or a source of death magic.

Death Touch.description: When a living creature is touched, the victim must make a Magic Resistance or die in 1d10 seconds.

Desert Endurance.description: The creature has a store of fatty tissue somewhere in its body which it draws upon when no other food or water source is available, allowing the creature to survive for up to 7 days without eating or drinking. As the creature expends energy from this fatty tissue, it is depleted and returns to normal after a full day of food and rest.

Destroy Divinity.description: Contact with a divine item or active invocation causes a chance for the divine item or invocation to be dispelled as per the invocation Dispel Divinity, at 2 Piety Control per level of the creature.

Destroy Magic.description: Contact with an Aura based item or active invocation causes a chance for the item or spell to be dispelled as per the invocation Dispel Magic, at 2 Aura points per level of the creature.

Destructive Voice.description: The creatures voice causes damage to those who hear it the body area where their hearing is located, ears (Head), unless they make a Magic Resistance.

Destructive Voice(Greater).description: The creatures voice causes damage to those who hear it to all body areas unless they make a Magic Resistance

Digestive Fluid.description: The creature secrets an external fluid which begins chemically dissolving its food source.

Discern Divine Connection.description: The being or creature can see the divine connections from all beings to their deities in the form of a divine cord emanating from the being and a symbol of the deity or belief system that creature worships. When viewing a deity, they see all the connections out form that deity to their worshippers.

Disease Carrier.description: The creature carries a disease. When the creature makes an appropriate form of contact with a victim, that victim requires a Disease Resistance to avoid contracting the disease.

Disease Bearing.description: The creature carries a disease. When the creature makes an appropriate form of contact with a victim, that victim requires a Disease Resistance to avoid contracting the disease.

Diseased Leaves.description: The plant carries a disease. When the plant makes an appropriate form of contact with a victim, that victim requires a Disease Resistance to avoid contracting the disease.

Diseased Fruit.description: Fruit, flower, bud, or seed carriers a disease harmful to beings, animals.

Disease Spores.description: The plant releases spores which carry a disease. When the spores are inhaled, that victim requires a Disease Resistance to avoid contracting the disease.

Diseased Spores.description: The plant releases spores which carry a disease. When the spores are inhaled, that victim requires a Disease Resistance to avoid contracting the disease.

Disintegration Touch.description: Touch causes living creatures to make a Magic Resistance or be disintegrated.

Disintegrating Touch.description: Touch causes living creatures to make a Magic Resistance or be disintegrated.

Divine Emotion.description: +10% to divine magical skills while affected by one emotion.

Divine Isolation.description: Being cannot use, create or be the focus of divine magical skills and invocations.

Divine Sense.description: The ability to sense divine magic, active invocations or supernatural beings.

Diving.description: Winged creatures can make arial attacks without Agility saves to avoid crashing. Swimming creatures gain the ability to hold their breath for long periods (up to 30 minutes). Gains the Social Skill Diving.

Dormant State.description: The creature can enter a dormant state where it`s body will take on different physical characteristics. During this time, intake of nutrients is not needed, but the creature loses one Endurance per month while in this state.

Dormant State(Advanced).description: The creature can enter a dormant state where it`s body will take on different physical characteristics. During this time, intake of nutrients is not needed, but the creature loses one Endurance per year while in this state.

Dormant State(Perfect).description: The creature can enter a dormant state where it`s body will take on different physical characteristics. During this time, intake of nutrients is not needed. The creature does not lose Endurance while in this state, regardless of the time it remains in this form.

Drain(Control).description: Added to any attribute drain ability, but if the victim`s attribute goes below zero, the victim is transformed into a creature of similar type under the control of the creature that drained it.

Drain(Death).description: Added to any attribute drain ability, but if the victim`s attribute goes below zero, the victim dies and the drain ability is permanent, no matter what form the victim takes in the future (resurrected, undead, etc.).

Drain(Mental).description: The ability to drain from a victim`s mental attribute and add that mental attribute to the rating of the creature`s identical mental attribute. Requires touch.

Drain(Mystical).description: The ability to drain from a victim`s mystical attribute and add that mystical attribute to the rating of the creature`s identical mystical attribute. Requires touch.

Drain(Personal).description: The ability to drain from a victim`s personal attribute, and add that personal attribute to the rating of the creature`s identical personal attribute (Social Class excluded). Requires touch.

Drain(Physical).description: The ability to drain from a victim`s physical attribute and add that physical attribute to the rating of the creature`s identical physical attribute. Requires touch.

Drain(Transformation).description: Added to any attribute drain ability, but if the victim`s attribute goes below zero, the victim is transformed into a creature of similar type.

Dream Slay.description: This creature`s attack can kill creatures on the dream plane or who are illusionary in nature. If the victim is an illusion or a dreamer projected onto the dreamscape, they have to make a Magic Resistance for each attack or they are killed. Dreamer projections are sent back to their plane of origin and must make a Will Force save or suffer a heart attack (see Master’s Manual). If the victim is actually present in the dreamscape, then this effect can actually kill permanently if a Magic Resistance fails but only natural to hit rolls of 21–1 per 2.5 creature levels: Level 1 (N/A), 2-4 (Natural 20), 5-9 (Natural 19+), 10-14 (Natural 18+), 15-19 (Natural 17+), 20-24 (Natural 16+), 29 (Natural 15+), 30 (Natural 14+).

Dream Touch.description: The physical touch (or attack) of the creature causes the target to make a Control Resistance or fall into a sleep state for 1-3 hours. If on the Dream Plane this instead sends those who are not Dreamers (those with the Dream Shift skill) back to their home planes. Beings who have physically traveled to the Dream Plane are not sent home, sleeping instead (a dream within a dream.)

Drift Seeds.description: Creates seeds with a small gas bladder attached, allowing them to drift with air currents.

Because of the ability of the creature to envelop, a +20% is added to the creature’s Agility roll vs the Victim. Once pinned envelopment begins. The victim can continue trying to escape but must do so at +10% accumulating penalties including the +20% for initial pin). Fatigue Drain.description: The creature slowly drains energy from the being in the form of mental and physical fatigue. Every hour the creature is in contact with a victim is drained and gains 1 level of physical and mental fatigue with no save or resistance. When the victim reaches the highest level of physical fatigue, he begins making a Vitality save at -50% every minute or be unable to move. When the victim reaches the highest level of mental fatigue, they begin making an Intelligence save at -50% every minute or fall unconscious. If they are also at the highest level of mental fatigue he begins to die and must make additional -50% Vitality saves every minute. When three such saves fail the victim dies.

Fatigue Touch(Mental).description: The creature`s touch causes the victim to make an intelligence save at -50% or drop 1 level of mental fatigue. When the victim reaches the highest level of mental fatigue, she begins making an intelligence save at -50% every minute or fall unconscious. If she is also at the highest level of physical fatigue, she begins to die and must make additional -50% Vitality saves every minute. When three such saves fail the victim dies.

Fatigue Touch(Physical).description: The creature`s touch causes the victim to make a Vitality save at -50% or lose 1 level of physical fatigue. When the victim reaches the highest level of physical fatigue, he begins making a Vitality save at -50% every minute or be unable to move. If he is also at the highest level of mental fatigue, he begins to die and must make additional -50% Vitality saves every minute. When three such saves fail the victim dies.

Force of Wood.description: +30% to the Force skill if the plant controls its limbs (i.e. sapient and mobile). Can also cause 1 point of structural damage per minute.

Rash lasts 3d4 days and causes 1 point of damage per day if itched. Itching must be resisted with Will Force save or some form of topical lotion.

Fruit/Flower/Bud/Seed(Diseased).description: Fruit, flower, bud, or seed carriers a disease harmful to beings, animals.

Fruit/Flower/Bud/Seed(Parasitic).description: Fruit, flower, bud, or seed is a parasitic agent.

Gaze(Mesmerization).description: A stronger version of Transfixing Gaze. All creatures or beings must make a Control Resistance or be mesmerized by the creature while in its presence, staring at it in wonder or horror. Strong shaking or other distractions (for 5 seconds) allow for a new Control resistance. Also blocking the affected being`s field of view for 5 seconds will remove the effect without save.

Gaze(Pain).description: When the creature gazes at a victim, the victim must make a Magic Resistance or suffer painful seizures and lose 1d4+1 seconds of action.

Gaze(Paralysis).description: When the creature gazes at a victim, the victim must make a Control Resistance or fall under the effects of the spell Paralysis as long as the victim is within sight of the creature.

Gaze(Sleep).description: When the creature gazes at a victim, the victim must make a Control Resistance fall asleep until awakened.

Gaze(Transfixing).description: When the creature gazes at a victim, the victim must make a Control Resistance or remain motionless until disturbed or shaken.

Gaze(Transmuting).description: When the creature gazes at a victim, the victim must make a Magic Resistance or be transmuted to Crystal, Flesh, Metal, Stone, or Wood.

Gas Bag.description: The creature has a pouch or bag that it can use to shoot forth a gas of some sort. The gas effect should be chosen by also choosing the Venom ability. The bag will refill at a rate of once per minute.

Gas Bladder.description: A bladder for lighter than air gasses that allows a creature to maintain neutral buoyancy in air.

Gas Bladder(Magical).description: A bladder for lighter than air gasses that allows an exotic creature to maintain neutral buoyancy in air and can be filled and refilled quickly by internal magical means. Gaseous Form.description: The creature can tum into a gaseous form. While in this form the creature cannot be harmed physically, but may be subject to powerful winds.

Gaseous Limb Regeneration.description: Regenerates 1 point per minute to limbs if in contact with gases.

Ghost Breeder.description: The rare ability for non-corporeal forms to reproduce. With this ability, two Detached Psyches can possess a single form (which must be a Mindless Husk) and breed a new Detached Psyche. Only one of the two psyches requires this ability, and that psyche must make preparations within the intended form for 24 hours minus 30 minutes per Will Force point. When the second being enters the intended form, the process of mating begins, during which the possessed form cannot be manipulated or moved. Mating lasts for 1 full day, after which the Ghost Breeder makes a Control Resistance. If successful, the Ghost Breeder permanently loses 1 Will Force point. Both psyches are cast out from the possessed form, and a new psyche is born within the form. This new being has characteristics of each parent and is able to maintain the currently possessed form for twice as long as normal (see Corporeal Possession). This is the only situation where two Detached Psyches may possess a single form at the same time.

Heat Sensing.description: Able to use heat to discern between objects.

Heat Sense.description: Able to use heat to discern between objects.

Heat(Plant).description: Plant can generate magical heat. Does 1d6 damage per cubic foot of Plant to beings contacting the Plant and needs 1 hour to recharge per d6 done.

Hibernation.description: Creature has the ability to sleep on stored fat for up to 3 months at a time. The creature will wake up ravenous and need to ingest double quantities of food for one day per week of hibernation. In addition, all physical attributes will be reduced by one per month of hibernation, returning at one per week per attribute and 2% of body weight per month of hibernation will have been lost, returning at 2% per week.

Hide.description: Creature has a protective hide that absorbs incoming damage.

Hide(Crystal Plant Fiber).description: Hide(Crystal Plant Fiber:1 per 2 END/20 Max.).

Hide Magical.description: As any other type of hide but magical allowing for greater armoring values without the usual thickness or stiffness.

Hide Thick.description: Has a thicker than normal hide.

Hide(Magical).description: As any other type of hide but magical allowing for greater armoring values without the usual thickness or stiffness.

Hide(Scales/Shell).description: Hide(Scales/Shell): 10 points, limbs, head, and neck. 20 points, upper, middle and lower torsos).

Hide(Supernatural).description: The creature has an invisible magic hide which acts like the spell Force Armor.

Hide(Thick).description: Has a thicker than normal hide.

High Metabolism.description: The creature has a +10% food intake requirement, -10% to weight, but a -2 Initiative bonus.

High Pain Threshold.description: The creature takes 1 less point of physical damage per blow from weapons or energy attacks.

High-Pain Threshold.description: The creature takes 1 less point of physical damage per blow from weapons or energy attacks.

Hooves.description: Creatures with Hooves gain a movement of Gallop (x4 walking).

Horns.description: Horns: Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat.

Horn.description: Horns: Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat.

Howl Communication.description: Howl Communication(communicate 5 miles +/-2.5 miles depending on condition).

Hypnotic Gaze.description: If the creature looks into the eyes of a being, the being must make a Control Resistance or stand motionless for 1d4 seconds.

Ice Affinity.description: Natural affinity with ice is very strong, resulting in a +10% to Cryokinesis and Animal Shape when transforming into an ice-based creature (such as an Ice Wisp).

Icy Touch.description: A body area or contact point steals heat from other beings, causing damage through armor (magic armor gets a save).

Illusions as Real.description: The creature can treat illusions as real, including doing damage to them and altering them as if they were real and affected by whatever the creature does. For example, a creature with this ability could attack an illusion of a person, treat it as if it has appropriate endurance and other characteristics and then “kill” and consume it.

Immortal.description: Does not age. Gains the Immunity:Aging.

Improved Disease Resistance.description: The creature is especially resistant to disease.

Improved Control Resistance.description: The creature is very difficult to control.

Improved Illusion Resistance.description: The creature is especially good at spotting illusions.

Improved Magic Resistance.description: The creature is especially magically resistant.

Improved Poison Resistance.description: The creature is especially resistant to poison.

Improved Phasing.description: The creature can phase and unphase all or only a desired portion of its body and exist on both planes.

Improved Spirit Form.description: Allows a Detached Psyche to last twice as long outside of a physical body as normal, without suffering ill effects. All periods of time describing ill effects are doubled before they are applied.

Improved Telepathy.description: The creature can connect mentally to other beings within sight, or by mental visualization if within one mile per Will Force rating. The creature can also initiate mental combat by sight.

Incendiary Fruit.description: This plant produces an incendiary fruit that explodes on contact doing 1d10 to 10d10.

Infected Spit/Pus Throw(Greater).description: Pus or spit is hurled up to 30 feet. If it strikes the victim, they must make a disease resistance at -20% or suffer a random disease which is always the worst possible form of that disease. It lasts for the longest period possible and the effects begin in 1d4x10 seconds.

Infected Spit/Pus Throw(Magical).description: Pus or spit is hurled up to 15 feet. If it strikes the victim, they must make a disease resistance at -10% or suffer a random disease which is always the worst possible form of that disease. It lasts for the longest period possible and the effects begin in 1d4x1 minutes.

Inflation.description: Can inflate one or more body areas up to 4 times normal size. All types of damage except piercing are halved, but piercing damage when inflated is x2 against the creature, and will cause deflation.).

Infrasonic Speech.description: Infrasonic Speech(Can speak in sounds so low that those without either Vibration Sensing or this ability cannot hear it. Distance goes x2 as far. Those with Vibration Sensing can feel the sound but not understand it.)

Infravision.description: Infravision(distinquish 5 degree temp differences at a range of 30-180` depending on the creature).

Ink Spray.description: The creature can emit from one body area a stream of ink underwater, which requires the victim struck to make a Perception check or lose sight of the creature within the ink cloud. After 10 seconds, a doubled Perception check may be attempted to locate the creature, which has since left the area.

Insanity Bite.description: The bite of this creature causes its victim to suffer one or more forms of insanity. Unless otherwise specified, the insanities suffered are random.

Insanity Touch.description: When the creature touches a victim, the victim must make a Will Force save or suffer a type of insanity.

Insanity Voice.description: When a victim hears the voice of the creature, the victim must make a Will Force save or suffer a type of insanity.

Insect Limbs.description: Insect Limbs(Extra pair of arms/forearms and hands with no fingers. All at 1/2 endurance. Each counts as an off hand with +5 seconds of action. +20% to Climb.)

Insect Wings.description: Insect Wings(Gains flight at 3x walking speed).

Intelligence.description: Has an increased Intelligence for a creature of it`s type.

Instinct(Time paradoxes).description: The creature can use its senses time paradoxes whever they occur accross dimensions and planes.

Instinct(Treasure:Gems).description: Treasure Sniffing(The sense of Smell can be used to find gems and jewelry).

Instinct(Young fae).description: The creature can use its senses to detect the direction and distance of the nearest creature of its type.

Instinct(Water).description: The creature can use its senses to detect the direction and distance of the nearest water source.

Insubstantial.description: The creature has no physical body. It may choose to project a conceived image of itself in the visible spectrum, but this `physical` aspect of the creature is never a vital area, and damage to it causes no harm to the creature itself. The vital area of the creature is in fact an magical energy center, located in one chosen area (connected as the ability Spirit Bound) which must be destroyed to kill the creature and can be seen with detect magic.

Invisibility.description: The creature can go invisible (per the spell). Aura is treated as the level of the creature x2.

Invisible.description: The creature can go invisible (per the spell). Aura is treated as the level of the creature x2.

Irritant.description: Causes a rash within 24 hours of contact of a fleshy beings skin. Rash lasts 3d4 days and causes 1 point of damage per day if itched. Itching must be resisted with Will Force save or some form of topical lotion.

Irritant Bark.description: Causes a rash within 24 hours of contact of a fleshy beings skin. Rash lasts 3d4 days and causes 1 point of damage per day if itched. Itching must be resisted with Will Force save or some form of topical lotion.

Irritant Leaves.description: Causes a rash within 24 hours of contact of a fleshy beings skin. Rash lasts 3d4 days and causes 1 point of damage per day if itched. Itching must be resisted with Will Force save or some form of topical lotion.

Irritant Spores.description: Causes a rash within 24 hours of contact of a fleshy beings skin. Rash lasts 3d4 days and causes 1 point of damage per day if itched. Itching must be resisted with Will Force save or some form of topical lotion.

Irritant Thorns.description: Causes a rash within 24 hours of contact of a fleshy beings skin. Rash lasts 3d4 days and causes 1 point of damage per day if itched. Itching must be resisted with Will Force save or some form of topical lotion.

Keen.description: Keen(opponent`s make morale check or flee).

Kicking Hairs.description: Kicking Hairs: Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat.

Large Claws.description: Large Claws: Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat.

Large Fangs.description: Large Fangs(Gains additional attacks in combat).

Large Tail.description: Gains a tail, 1x Endurance body area.

Large Tail Stinger.description: Gains a stinger tail, 1x Endurance body area (Gains additional attacks in combat).

Leaves(Camouflage).description: Leaves that can camouflage the plant, making it require a perception check to be seen.

Leaves(Condenser).description: Has special leaves that can condense water directly from the air.

Leaves(Diseased).description: The plant carries a disease. When the plant makes an appropriate form of contact with a victim, that victim requires a Disease Resistance to avoid contracting the disease.

Leaves(Irritant).description: Causes a rash within 24 hours of contact of a fleshy beings skin. Rash lasts 3d4 days and causes 1 point of damage per day if itched. Itching must be resisted with Will Force save or some form of topical lotion.

Leaves(Parasitic).description: A Disease Resistance is required or the being or animal is infected with a parasitic agent.

Leaves(Poisonous).description: Poison(secretes or releases a poison on its leaves).

Leaves(Razor).description: The leaves have sharpened edges that cause ld4+2 to all areas that contact them.

Leaves(Reflective).description: The plant has reflective leaves that can focus light/heat to a central point. By themselves they can only do damage if there is a strong light source (such as the sun).

Leaves(Sharp).description: Sharpened leaves or nettles that cause damage to areas contacted.

Leaves(Sonic).description: Some of the plant`s leaves are stiff and can be vibrated to produce a kind a song voice.

Leaves(Sticky Mucous).description: Causes a Strength save to remove once per 10 seconds, -5% per square foot of sticky plant material contacting the being.

Leaves(Venomous).description: Venom(secretes or releases a venom on its leaves).

Lesser Chaos Voice.description: When the creature laughs or speaks for 5 seconds all who hear must make an Intelligence Save or mistake friend for foe for the next action.

Lesser Confusion Gaze.description: All who meet the gaze of the creature must make a Control Resistance or lose 1d4+1 seconds.

Lesser Death Touch.description: When a living creature is touched, the victim must make a Magic Resistance or suffer a heart attack: 6d6 damage to the upper torso. No actions may be taken for 1d4 minutes. The victim must make a Vitality save or lose 1 Vitality rating permanently.

Levitation Bladder.description: Grants the ability to levitate magically.

Light as Water.description: Light as Water(Uses light as a normal creature would water. 3 days of absolute darkness will kill this creature. 1 minute of light is a drink. 3 drinks are needed per day.)

Light Sleeper.description: Light Sleeper(Awakens in 1 second after any disturbing noise is heard or a Danger Knowledge skill roll is made).

Light Sleeping.description: Light Sleeper(Awakens in 1 second after any disturbing noise is heard or a Danger Knowledge skill roll is made).

Light Touch.description: This creature has a focused magical light emission that requires touch to damage. Those touched require a successful Magic Resistance or damage is taken. Also lights an area brightly in a 10-foot radius per level (or Title) of the creature and casts a dim light at a radius up to 3x level.

Light-based Regeneration.description: Regeneration of 1 point of damage, per 10 minutes in full sunlight, to all wounded areas.

Liquid Limb Regeneration.description: Regenerates 1 point per minute to limbs if in contact with liquids.

Limb Regeneration(Death).description: Regenerates 1 point per minute to limbs if in contact with a corpse or a source of death magic.

Limb Regeneration(Earthen).description: Regenerates 1 point per minute to limbs if in contact with earth or rock.

Limb Regeneration(Gaseous).description: Regenerates 1 point per minute to limbs if in contact with gases.

Limb Regeneration(Heat).description: Regenerates 1 point per minute to limbs if in contact with heat source capable of boiling water or an open flame.

Limb Regeneration(Liquid).description: Regenerates 1 point per minute to limbs if in contact with liquids.

Limb Regeneration(Living).description: Regenerates 1 point per minute to limbs if in contact with a living thing.

Limb Regeneration(Magic).description: Regenerates 1 point per minute to limbs if in contact with a source of a source of magic.

Limbs(Scythe).description: Has hands or feet that end in a cutting blade made of bone, carapace, or other hardened material. Does damage equal to a bite attack +1 dice for a creature of that size. Attack speed is 5 seconds, 3 min.

Limbs(Spear).description: Has hands or feet that end in a spear-likehead that can be used to pierce opponents. It is made of bone, carapace or other hardened material. Its damage is equal to a double claw attack for a creature of that size. Attack speed is 5 seconds, 2 min.

Living Crystal.description: Living Crystal(Gains abilities Breathless, Heat as Food, and Light as Water and is in a moving crystal form).

Living Limb Regeneration.description: Regenerates 1 point per minute to limbs if in contact with a living thing.

Life Sense.description: The ability to sense positive and negative life energies, as per the skill.

Life Sensing.description: The ability to sense positive and negative life energies, as per the skill.

Limited Mobility.description: A limited part of the plant can move.

Limited Telepathy.description: The creature can connect mentally to other beings within sight, but does not have the ability to initiate mental combat.

Limitless Carry.description: The being or creature can carry anything they can lift. Size becomes the issue, not weight.

Long Lived.description: Lives 150% of its normal life span (decline begins at 120%).

Magic Absorption.description: Any Magic Resistances made cause the Aura points in the spell to be absorbed by the creature into its own Aura Pool.

Magic Limb Regeneration.description: Regenerates 1 point per minute to limbs if in contact with a source of a source of magic.

Magic Sense.description: The ability to sense magic, active spells or magical beings.

Magical Acid Sap.description: Can release extremely corrosive sap causing 1d10 per 10 seconds to all objects that contact it. Can only release one dose per cubic foot of plant per hour.

Magical Bones.description: Has magical bones (generally to support great weight).

Magical Disease Bearing.description: The creature is a carrier for a magical disease.

Magical Disease Touch.description: When the creature touches a victim, the victim must make a Disease Resistance at -10% or suffer a random disease which is always the worst possible form of that disease. It lasts for the longest period possible and the effects begin in 1d4x1 minutes.

Magical Fear.description: Sight of the creature causes beings to flee with a failed Control Resistance.

Magical Feeling.description: The creature has a tactile sense and can feel physical objects, even if it has no physical nerves for feeling.

Magical Flight.description: Magical Flight(Gains the magical ability to fly without wings).

Magical Insanity.description: Creature is so hideous or so weird as to cause a Will Force save to avoid a random insanity by all who view it.

Magical Levitation.description: Grants the ability to levitate magically.

Magical Poisonous Skin.description: The creature has a magical poison on its skin. The poison takes effect when only when the creature has its skin touched (contact).

Magical Poisonous Spit.description: The creature can spit poison of the contact variety.

Magical Venom.description: The creature has a magical poison ability (type XXI and higher) that is ingestive and must be combined with claws, fangs, stinger, etc..

Magic Emotion.description: +10% to magical skills while affected by one emotion.

Magma Skin.description: Contact with the creature causes fire damage per second if a Magic Resistance is failed.

Malleable Form.description: Has a form that can change shape though it may have a default appearance. These beings may have some cartilage or bone-like structures but all areas besides (one) chosen by the creature to house its brain/nucleus are considered limbs and not vital. The default vital area is mid-torso if in humanoid shape, though they can change at whim once per minute. It can change its shape and size to match a victim it has had contact with for more than an hour.

Mandible.description: Mandibles(Gains additional attacks in combat. After hit creature is considered grappled STR Contest to escape).

Mandibles.description: Mandibles(Gains additional attacks in combat. After hit creature is considered grappled STR Contest to escape).

Marsupial Pouch.description: The creature contains a hidden fold of skin which holds 6 cubic inches per 20 Endurance (normally used for holding young).

Massmind(Parasitic).description: The plant is the central agent in a massmind, if the plant has the Brain ability then it is the overmind. Each person who contacts this parasite must make a Control Resistance or be mentally converted to a massmind shared by the other victims of this plant.

Maw.description: Maw: Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat.

Maw(Plant).description: The plant has a mouth that can be used to grind pray, usually to store in a central chamber for slow digestion. The mouth does damage based on the size of the plant. Plants can have more than one Maw.

Mechanical Engine.description: Mechanical Engine(Has a Mechanical engine. Must be fed energy through a described mechanism. Power sources are as follows: Clockwork: 10 minutes of winding per day; Steam: 10 gallons of water per day; Combustion: 10 pounds of flammable material per day. If this energy runs out, then the being becomes immobile and unconscious. Outside influence is needed to be restarted. This engine fills the being`s entire torso, and if destroyed, so is the being. Also has the disabilities Infertile, No Healing, No Regeneration, No Resurrection, No Sense of Smell, and No Sense of Taste.)

Mecho-magical Grafting.description: Additional mechanical or magical limbs or locomotive units may be grafted to this being with Metal Lore, Wood Lore, Crystal Lore, or Stone Lore and the being then gains control of them. No more than 1 pair of limbs may be grafted per torso. A locomotive unit equals two limbs (replacing legs, shins, and feet).

Mecho-Magical Grafting.description: Additional mechanical or magical limbs or locomotive units may be grafted to this being with Metal Lore, Wood Lore, Crystal Lore, or Stone Lore and the being then gains control of them. No more than 1 pair of limbs may be grafted per torso. A locomotive unit equals two limbs (replacing legs, shins, and feet).

Mecho-magical Mind.description: Has a mind made of small moving parts, magical in nature. If the mind is destroyed, then the being dies. Gains the following Immunities: Sleepless, Fear, Hold.

Mecho-Magical Mind.description: Has a mind made of small moving parts, magical in nature. If the mind is destroyed, then the being dies. Gains the following Immunities: Sleepless, Fear, Hold.

Mecho-mechanical Repair.description: The creature`s mechanical body can be willed by it to be repaired mechanically 1x day.

Mecho-Mechanical Repair.description: The creature`s mechanical body can be willed by it to be repaired mechanically 1x day.

Mecho-magical Repair.description: The creature`s magical or mechanical body can be willed by it to be repaired magically (as per the repair spell) 1x day.

Mecho-Magical Repair.description: The creature`s magical or mechanical body can be willed by it to be repaired magically (as per the repair spell) 1x day.

Mecho-magical Repair(Automatic).description: As Mecho-magical Repair but repair occurs automatically 1x day even if the creature is dead or non-functioning.

Mecho-Magical Repair(Automatic).description: As Mecho-magical Repair but repair occurs automatically 1x day even if the creature is dead or non-functioning.

Medium Claws.description: Claws: Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat.

Mental Drain.description: The ability to drain from a victim`s mental attribute and add that mental attribute to the rating of the creature`s identical mental attribute (touch).

Metabolic Control(Low).description: This creature can shift between slow, normal and high metabolism at will.

Metabolic Control(High).description: This creature can shift to any metabolic rate; very slow, slow, normal, high and very high.

Metabolic Control(Partial Petrification).description: The ability to slow metabolism so much that the body partially petrifies magically leaving a small channel between the brain, lungs, heart, ears and eyes active but everything else dormant so that very little energy is consumed. Aging/energy consumption is reduced to 1 day per month.

Metabolic Control(Partial Crystallizatio.description: The ability to slow metabolism so much that the body partially crystalizes magically leaving a small channel between the brain, lungs, heart, ears, and eyes active but everything else dormant so that very little energy is consumed. Aging/energy consumption is reduced to 1 day per month. While in this state, all damage taken is halved.

Metabolic Control(Two-Stage Low).description: This creature can shift between normal metabolism and very slow metabolism.

Metabolic Control(Two-Stage High).description: This creature can shift between normal metabolism and very high metabolism.

Metal Mechanical Form.description: Has a metallic mechanical body that has built-in armor equaling 1 point per 3 Endurance of the being with no maximum. Gain attacks: Punch (4 seconds, 2 minimum for 3d4+3 smashing), Kick (5 seconds, 3 minimum for 3d6+3 smashing) These beings cannot wear normal rigid or even semi-flexible armor as it would interfere with their locomotion. They can wear any flexible armor available. Also gains the following Immunities: Aging, Transformation of Form, Poison (Greater), Disease, Fatigue, and Shock, and are both Fire and Cold hardened (+10% magic resistance to heat or cold, -1 damage per die).

Metal-Mechanical Form.description: Has a metallic mechanical body that has built-in armor equaling 1 point per 3 Endurance of the being with no maximum. Gain attacks: Punch (4 seconds, 2 minimum for 3d4+3 smashing), Kick (5 seconds, 3 minimum for 3d6+3 smashing) These beings cannot wear normal rigid or even semi-flexible armor as it would interfere with their locomotion. They can wear any flexible armor available. Also gains the following Immunities: Aging, Transformation of Form, Poison (Greater), Disease, Fatigue, and Shock, and are both Fire and Cold hardened (+10% magic resistance to heat or cold, -1 damage per die).

Metamorphic Mimic.description: Mimics and produces a copy of a humanoid mind and body.

Mesmerization Gaze.description: A stronger version of Transfixing Gaze. All creatures or beings must make a Control Resistance or be mesmerized by the creature while in its presence, staring at it in wonder or horror. Strong shaking or other distractions (for 5 seconds) allow for a new Control resistance. Also blocking the affected being`s field of view for 5 seconds will remove the effect without save.

Mid Hands.description: Digging claws are replaced with fully functioning hands (treated as off-hands), resulting in a loss of the Digging ability with that particular appendage pair.

Mimic.description: Can mimic or copy voices or sounds as the skill Mimic with only a single hearing of the noise.

Mimic Mind.description: The creature can absorb the knowledge, thought structure, and non-magical, non-divine skills and abilities of a victim it has beaten in mental combat or possessed for at least one hour. They continue to have their own separate mind but can access and act as if they were the being whose mind they mimic.

Mind Reader.description: Gains the racial skill Thought Projection at +20%.

Mind Sense.description: The ability to sense the presence of sapient minds, within whatever range is allowed by other senses.

Mind Wipe Touch.description: Touch causes the victim to make a Control Resistance or forget about the being or creature.

Mobility.description: Plant has ability to move branches and even uproot itself. Speed and ability vary by plant

Morphing.description: Creature can change its shape, size and/or color to appear to be anything else about which it is knowledge.

Mucous.description: A thick Mucous is secreted by some portion of the creatures anatomy. Anyone who touches or steps into it must make a Strength save or be stuck. The being can try to free itself each 10 seconds. The mucous will not stick to the creature who secretes it.

Musk Spray.description: The creature can emit from one body area a stream of obnoxious liquid. This spray requires the victim struck to make a Vitality save once per 10 seconds or be incapacitated for 1d10 x 3 seconds. Afterwards, the victim is covered in the stench and is -4 to Charm and Appearance. If the liquid is washed off, these attributes are only at -2 and the stench remains on the skin for 3d4 days.

Mystical Drain.description: The ability to drain from a victim`s mystical attribute and add that mystical attribute to the rating of the creature`s identical mystical attribute. Requires touch.

Nervous System.description: The plant has a animal like nervous system within its trunks/stems/leaves. It can sense and react to tactile stimulation more than just locally. (Some leaves and stems of plants are tactile sensitive reacting locally when touched).

Nightvision.description: Night Vision(Near darkness vision. Bright light: blinds 1d6+1 sec. -2 to hit/+1 initiative after).

Night Vision.description: Night Vision(Near darkness vision. Bright light: blinds 1d6+1 sec. -2 to hit/+1 initiative after).

Night Vision(Enhanced).description: Night Vision(Enhanced):(Near darkness vision. No bright light penalties.)

Night Vision Enhanced.description: Night Vision(Enhanced):(Near darkness vision. No bright light penalties.)

Nightvision(Enhanced).description: Night Vision(Enhanced):(Near darkness vision. No bright light penalties.)

Night Vision(Improved).description: Night Vision(Enhanced):(Near darkness vision. No bright light penalties.)

Not Easily Surprised.description: Not Easily Surprised(-15% to be Surprised).

Null Magic.description: Being cannot use, create or be the focus of magical skills and spells.

Omnidextrous.description: The creature has can use all limbs independently and has a full 10 seconds in combat for each body area, where practical.

Padded Feet.description: The creature has thick, padded feet which help to walk on shifting, loose surfaces like sand and snow.

Pain Gaze.description: When the creature gazes at a victim, the victim must make a Magic Resistance or suffer painful seizures and lose 1d4+1 seconds of action.

Paralysis Gaze.description: When the creature gazes at a victim, the victim must make a Control Resistance or fall under the effects of the spell Paralysis as long as the victim is within sight of the creature.

Paralysis Touch.description: When the creature touches a victim, the victim must make a Control Resistance or fall under the effects of the spell Paralysis as long as the victim is within sight of the creature.

Paralytic Touch.description: When the creature touches a victim, the victim must make a Control Resistance or fall under the effects of the spell Paralysis as long as the victim is within sight of the creature.

Parasitic Agents(Simple).description: Causes a parasitic infection in living beings. This parasitic infection is an advance form of disease allowing a Disease Resistance to avoid. Failure indicates a loss of 1-3 physical and 1-2 mental for the duration of the infection. The infection duration varies.

Parasitic Agents(Mood Altering:dispair).description: Parasitic Agent:A Disease Resistance is required or the victim feels an intense feeling of despair and hopelessness. If a Control Resistance is failed, the victim must make a -70% Will Force save to avoid succumbing to the plant, and cease all defensive actions. If the Will Force save was fails by more than 20%, the victim will then try to convince any other beings under attack to cease all attempts to fight back as well. All feelings of despair endure for a maximum of 1d4 days or until the plant is destroyed.)

Parasitic Agents(Mood Altering:violent).description: Parasitic Agent:a Disease Resistance is required or the being or animal becomes uncontrollably violent and sees all moving things as a threat; +50% to Berserking during this state. Ends (as Berserking) in 1d4 minutes.

Parasitic Agents(Mood Altering:passive).description: Parasitic Agent:a Disease Resistance is required or the being or animal becomes nearly catatonicaly passive. Mental facilities are halved. The being can be lead around but will take direct actions only after making an Intelligence save to do so and a Will Force save to overcome the passivity. This effect lasts 1d4 hours.

Parasitic Agents(Mood Altering:paranoia).description: Parasitic Agent:the being becomes deeply afraid and phobic. Anything that could possibly be a danger requires a Control Resistance. lf this fails the being has entered a state of fear. A further Will Force determines how the being reacts to this fear. lf made the being cowers but does not run. If failed the being runs until the danger cannot be seen or felt to be near. This effect lasts 1d4 hours.

Parasitic Agents(Mood Altering:protect).description: Upon touching the plant, a Disease Resistance is required or the being or animal will feel intense protective feelings for the plant. If a Control Resistance fails as well then the being or animal will become a guardian for the plant and keep others from harming it, unable to leave the vicinity of the plant until control is broken or the plant dies. The effect lasts 1d4 days per exposure.

Parasitic Bark.description: Parasitic Agent:a Disease Resistance is required or the being or animal is infected with a parasitic agent.

Parasitic Conversion(Food).description: Upon touching the plant, the failure of a Disease Resistance causes the being to fall into a deep sleep and die in 1d4 hours. After death the body will quickly (1d4 more hours) decay into a rich fertilizer that is pulpy and seeps into the ground.

Parasitic Conversion(Plant).description: Upon touching the plant, a Disease Resistance is required; Failure indicates the being falls into a deep unwakeable sleep. The being converts into the plant type over the course of 1d4+1 days.

Parasitic Leaves.description: A Disease Resistance is required or the being or animal is infected with a parasitic agent.

Parasitic Massmind.description: The plant is the central agent in a massmind, if the plant has the Brain ability then it is the overmind. Each person who contacts this parasite must make a Control Resistance or be mentally converted to a massmind shared by the other victims of this plant.

Parasitic Visual Connection.description: The creature replaces the host`s visual system with its own sensing abilities.

Parasitic(Massmind).description: The plant is the central agent in a massmind, if the plant has the Brain ability then it is the overmind. Each person who contacts this parasite must make a Control Resistance or be mentally converted to a massmind shared by the other victims of this plant.

Parasitic Mood Altering(Despair).description: Parasitic Agent:A Disease Resistance is required or the victim feels an intense feeling of despair and hopelessness. If a Control Resistance is failed, the victim must make a -70% Will Force save to avoid succumbing to the plant, and cease all defensive actions. If the Will Force save fails by more than 20%, the victim will then try to convince any other beings under attack to cease all attempts to fight back as well. All feelings of despair endure for a maximum of 1d4 days or until the plant is destroyed.)
