Partially Detached Psyche.description: Doubles the amount of time a Detached Psyche may maintain possession of a physical form.

Patterned(Fur/Feathers).description: Patterned Fur/Scales:(+10% to Blend/+5% to Move Unseen in matching terrain).

Patterned Fur.description: Patterned Fur(or Scales):(+10% to Blend/+5% to Move Unseen in matching terrain).

Patterned Scales.description: Patterned Scales:(+10% to Blend/+5% to Move Unseen in matching terrain).

Permanent Poison.description: The poison alters the victim`s own hormone and/or endocrine system and becomes permanent until the poison is removed.

Personal Drain.description: The ability to drain from a victim`s personal attribute, and add that personal attribute to the rating of the creature`s identical personal attribute (Social Class excluded). Requires touch.

Phaseable Form.description: The creature`s form is on the phase plane. May also have less actual body areas, the rest being permeable projections.

Phasing.description: The innate ability to phase and unphase.

Physical Drain.description: The ability to drain from a victim`s physical attribute and add that physical attribute to the rating of the creature`s identical physical attribute through touch.

Piety.description: Has an increased Piety for a creature of it`s type.

Pigmented Features.description: Allows colored skin, eyes, and hair. Removes all Light disabilities. Normally given to a creature whose features are usually white or translucent.

Pincers.description: Pincers(Gains additional attacks in combat. After hit creature is considered grappled STR Contest to escape).

Pincers/Mandibles.description: Pincers(Gains additional attacks in combat. After hit creature is considered grappled STR Contest to escape).

Plant Constriction.description: Constricts based on special senses. Does damage based on type of constricting plant fiber and number. Vines do 1d4+1 per 10 seconds per vine, branches do 2d6+2 per 10 seconds, trunks do 3d6+3 per 10 seconds.

Plant Eyes.description: The plant has eyes or eye stalks that can sense visually (requires nervous system).

Plant Gas Bladder.description: A bladder for lighter than air gasses produced through photosynthesis that allow a plant to maintain neutral buoyancy in air.

Plant Maw.description: The plant has a mouth that can be used to grind pray, usually to store in a central chamber for slow digestion. The mouth does damage based on the size of the plant. Plants can have more than one Maw.

Possession(Plant).description: Gains the power of Plant Possession, 3x day.

Poison Spores.description: The plant releases a poison in spore form.

Poison Sleep.description: Failure indicates victim falls immediately asleep.

Poison(Bliss).description: A poison that causes someone to feel intense pleasure and be unable to take any other actions while affected.

Poison(Protector).description: A powerful love agent that causes the being to protect the creature, often violently.

Poison(Psychedelic).description: A poison that causes hallucinations of whatever the being desires or imagines.

Poison(Sleep).description: Failure indicates victim falls immediately asleep.

Poison(Sleep/Paralysis).description: A combination poison that puts those who fail resistance into a dreamless sleep with complete paralysis.

Poison(Strong).description: Poison(Strong):(Poison Type = Title x2, Potency J).

Poison(Strong Paralysis).description: Failure indicates victim is paralyzed for 1d4 hours.

Poison(Toxic Psychedelic).description: poison that causes hallucinations of whatever the being desires or imagines. Also does 1 point of brain damage per poison period (hours, minutes, seconds, etc.) The brain is a 1/10th area.

Poison(Permanent).description: The poison alters the victim`s own hormone and/or endocrine system and becomes permanent until the poison is removed.

Poisonous Leaves.description: The plants`s leaves is coated with contact venom.

Poisonous Skin.description: The creature`s skin is coated with contact venom.

Poisonous Magical Spit.description: The creature can spit a magical contact venom.

Poisonous Spit.description: The creature can spit a contact venom.

Poisonous Thorns.description: The plants`s thorns is coated with contact venom.

Polishing Pouch.description: Has a marsupial like pouch that can polish objects until they are circular and shiny.

Prehensile Limb.description: Prehensile Limb(Acts as a third hand but without the ability to delicately manipulate objects.)

Prehensile Limbs.description: Prehensile Limbs(Act as extra hands but without the ability to delicately manipulate objects.)

Prehensile Tail.description: Prehensile Tail(Acts as a third hand but without the ability to delicately manipulate objects. The tail has x1 Endurance and adds +20% to Climb.)

Prehensile Tail Slap.description: Tail Slap: Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat.

Razor Leaves.description: The leaves have sharpened edges that cause ld4+2 to all areas that contact them.

Quadruped.description: Quadruped(Gains Gallop/+20% to Agility saves/except trampling at -10%).

Quiet Flier.description: Quiet Flyer:The creature is at +20% to surprise when attacking from the air.

Quiet Flyer.description: Quiet Flyer:The creature is at +20% to surprise when attacking from the air.

Quills.description: Quills: Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat.

Quills(Burrowing).description: These quills are either thrown or attach by touching. They only stick to areas exposed or lightly protected, if at least 1 point of flesh damage is done. Initial damage is the same as claw damage for a creature of that size. Then that same damage is done again each minute the victim is not still.

Quick Breed.description: The creature can produce offspring in 1/2 the normal time.

Read All.description: The being or creature can read, any language or cipher, even magical ones.

Reduced Consumption.description: Reduced Consumption(needs half the normal amount of food and water to survive).

Reflective Leaves/Petals.description: The plant has reflective leaves or petals that can focus light/heat to a central point. By themselves they can only do damage if there is a strong light source (such as the sun).

Regeneration.description: Regeneration:(1d4 points are healed to all areas per minute. Cannot regenerate from fire or acid damage, or if the head and heart are separated).

Regeneration Budding.description: Regeneration-Budding:(If the creature is cut into two or more sections, each section will grow into a new but smaller version of the creature. Creatures cannot regenerate from fire or acid damage, or if the head is separated from the heart of the creature.

Regeneration(Accelerated).description: Accelerated Regeneration: +4 points per 10 seconds to all wounds; double this regeneration rate if resting.

Regeneration(Acid).description: All acid damage to the creature is absorbed and heals all wounds on a 1 for 1 for basis.

Regeneration(Budding).description: Regeneration-Budding:(If the creature is cut into two or more sections, each section will grow into a new but smaller version of the creature. Creatures cannot regenerate from fire or acid damage, or if the head is separated from the heart of the creature.

Regeneration(Chaos).description: Healing and regeneration effects are x3 when they see beings with chaos effects (touch of chaos) or are confused.

Regeneration(Chaos:Lesser).description: Healing and regeneration effects are x2 when they see beings with chaos effects (touch of chaos) or are confused.

Regeneration(Chaos:Greater).description: Healing and regeneration effects are x4 when they see beings with chaos effects (touch of chaos) or are confused.

Regeneration(Cold).description: All cold/frost damage to the creature is absorbed and heals all wounds on a 1 for 1 for basis.

Regeneration(Complete).description: Any part of the plant can re-grow into a complete plant at 1d4 Endurance per 10 seconds per day if exposed to water and nutrients. This plant has no vital areas.

Regeneration(Control).description: Healing and regeneration effects are x3 when controlling another being.

Regeneration(Control:Lesser).description: Healing and regeneration effects are x2 when controlling another being.

Regeneration(Control:Greater).description: Healing and regeneration effects are x4 when controlling another being.

Regeneration(Death).description: Healing and regeneration effects are x3 when a being has died near them that hour.

Regeneration(Death:Lesser).description: Healing and regeneration effects are x2 when controlling another being.

Regeneration(Death:Greater).description: Healing and regeneration effects are x4 when a being has died near them that hour.

Regeneration(Disease).description: Healing and regeneration effects are x3 while another being near them is diseased.

Regeneration(Disease:Lesser).description: Healing and regeneration effects are x2 while another being near them is diseased.

Regeneration(Disease:Greater).description: Healing and regeneration effects are x4 while another being near them is diseased.

Regeneration(Electrical).description: All electrical damage to the creature is absorbed and heals all wounds on a 1 for 1 for basis.

Regeneration(Heat).description: All fire/heat damage to the creature is absorbed and heals all wounds on a 1 for 1 for basis.

Regeneration(Fire).description: All fire/heat damage to the creature is absorbed and heals all wounds on a 1 for 1 for basis.

Regeneration Greater.description: Regeneration-Greater:(Regenerates 1d4 points to all wounds per 10 sec. Limbs regenerate and are restored when fully healed. Vital area loss causes death.)

Regeneration(Greater).description: Regeneration-Greater:(Regenerates 1d4 points to all wounds per 10 sec. Limbs regenerate and are restored when fully healed. Vital area loss causes death.)

Regeneration(Frost).description: All cold/frost damage to the creature is absorbed and heals all wounds on a 1 for 1 for basis.

Regeneration(Natural).description: Regeneration-Natural:(Lost limbs regrow at VIT healing rate. They appear first as buds and then fill out as they heal. Creature cannot regenerate from fire/acid. Death if the head and heart are seperated.)

Regeneration(Pain).description: Healing and regeneration effects are x3 when causing another being pain.

Regeneration(Pain:Lesser).description: Healing and regeneration effects are x2 when causing another being pain.

Regeneration(Pain:Greater).description: Healing and regeneration effects are x4 when causing another being pain.

Regeneration(Plant).description: Any severed areas of the plant will grow back, given enough food and water, at 5 Endurance per day.

Regeneration(Root).description: Any trunk or stem of the plant can grow roots if exposed to water (1d4 endurance per day). Chopping up the plant usually results in many smaller plants taking root.

Regeneration(Shadow).description: Healing and regeneration effects are x3 in shadow.

Regeneration(Shadow:Lesser).description: Healing and regeneration effects are x2 in shadow.

Regeneration(Shadow:Greater).description: Healing and regeneration effects are x4 in shadow.

Regeneration(Slow).description: Regeneration-Slow:(Limbs/non-head vitals heal at double normal healing rate. Beheading/fatal head damage causes death.)

Regeneration(Superior).description: Regeneration-Superior:(heal 1d6 points to all wounds per 10 sec. Limbs regenerate and are restored when fully healed. Vital area loss causes death.)

Regeneration(Ultra).description: Regeneration-Ultra:(Regenerates 1 point to all wounds per second unless acid damaged. Limbs regenerate and are restored when fully healed. Head or upper torso loss still cause death (brain/heart).

Rending Teeth.description: Rending Teeth:(Gains additional attacks in combat).

Reproductive Spores.description: The plant releases spores. Spores require a Poison Resistance to avoid; if failed 1d10 in lost seconds sneezing. A few (1-5%) of beings and animals will be allergic suffering weakness of -(1-2) physical attributes for 1d4 hours after exposure. Can release spores no more than once per week and most varieties do so once per season or once per lifetime of the plant.

Repulsion Field.description: All attacks or movements against the creature require a Strength save. Failure means the attacker or object is pushed back 2d10 feet. Success indicates that the attack or action may continue but all physical damage is halved. Missile weapons are ineffective against this creature regardless of save.

Repulsive Weapon Resistance.description: Requires a half strength save to even attempt to hit. All damage is reduced by half before also factoring in the damage type. Thus, smashing does no damage, cutting does quarter, and piercing does half.

Repulsion Weapon Resistance.description: Requires a half strength save to even attempt to hit. All damage is reduced by half before also factoring in the damage type. Thus, smashing does no damage, cutting does quarter, and piercing does half.

Reverse Aging.description: This creature ages backward. Starting from their eldest age and becoming younger until they reach their smallest size and capabilities.

Roar.description: The creature can emit a cry which causes fear (as the skill Fear) All failing a Control Resistance will flee. Beings with a 15 or better Will Force are unaffected.

Roar/Scream.description: The creature can emit a cry which causes fear (as the skill Fear) All failing a Control Resistance will flee. Beings with a 15 or better Will Force are unaffected.

Root(Moisture Cups).description: Has cupped roots that allow condensation to pool in them, drinking only in the central base hub.

Scaly Skin.description: Otherwise smooth skin is covered in hard scales, acting as 10 points of hide but resulting in -2 to Appearance.

Scream.description: The creature can emit a cry which causes fear (as the skill Fear) All failing a Control Resistance will flee. Beings with a 15 or better Will Force are unaffected.

Sea Companion.description: Gains the Skills Speak to Animal and Tame Animal, applicable only toward marine and aquatic creatures.

Seasonal Dormancy.description: Most plants have a time (winter/fall) when the go into a dormancy, conserving their energy and no longer taking substance to any degree or growing. This is marked by a loss of foliation and a changing in color.

Self-sustaining.description: Has no need of sustenance, ingested liquid, nor sleep.

Self-Sustaining.description: Has no need of sustenance, ingested liquid, nor sleep.

Sense Supernatural.description: The ability to sense supernatural beings, exactly as the skill of the same name.

Sense the Dead.description: The being can hear and see the dead (phased ghosts etc).

Sense The Dead.description: The being can hear and see the dead (phased ghosts etc).

Sense(Emotion).description: The ability to sense emotion in others.

Sense(Divine).description: The ability to sense divine magic, active invocations or supernatural beings.

Sense(Life).description: The ability to sense positive and negative life energies, as per the skill.

Sense(Magic).description: The ability to sense magic, active spells or magical beings.

Sense(Metal).description: The ability to sense metal or metallic ore.

Sense(Mind).description: The ability to sense the presence of sapient minds, within whatever range is allowed by other senses.

Sense(Poison).description: The ability to sense poisons, natural or magical in origin.

Sense(Poisons).description: The ability to sense poisons, natural or magical in origin.

Sense Future(All Senses).description: The ability to use all their senses to sense the future within an area, an object, or being, and sense what it may feel like in the future, including any additions or removals of other shapes and objects. The creature may choose to sense within an area no larger than 1 cubic foot per Creature Level: choosing either one specific time period no later than 100 years per Creature Level, or by choosing to sense anything within that area, skipping ahead in time at a rate of 1 day per minute. The creature may also choose to sense something as it may be in the future at a rate of 1 day per minute, until the very moment of its destruction.

Sense Future(Hearing).description: The ability to either hear sounds within an area or coming from an object (or being) as they are likely to be emitted in the future. The creature may choose to hear all sounds within an area no larger than 1 cubic foot per Creature Level as they may be emitted in the future by choosing either one specific time period no later than 100 years per Creature Level, or by choosing to listen to the various sounds within that designated area at a rate of 1 day per minute. The creature may also choose to follow an object`s (or being`s) possible physical journey by tracking its emitted sounds further and further forward in time until the last moment of its destruction.

Sense Future(Sight).description: The ability to see either an area or an object (or being) as it may appear in the future. The creature may choose to view an area no larger than 1 cubic foot per Creature Level as it may appear in the future by choosing either one specific time period no later than 100 years per Creature Level, or by choosing to watch that designated area skip forward in time at a rate of 1 day per minute. The creature may also choose to observe an object`s (or being`s) possible future further and further forward in time at a rate of the creature`s choosing, until the very moment of its destruction.

Sense Future(Smell).description: The ability to smell either an area or object (or being) as it may smell in the future. The creature may choose to smell an area no larger than 1 cubic foot per Creature Level as it may smell in the future by choosing either one specific time period no later than 100 years per Creature Level, or by choosing to observe the various smells within that designated area at a rate of 1 day per minute. The creature may also choose to retrace an object’s (or being`s) physical journey by tracking its smell further and further forward in time until the last moment of its destruction.

Sense Future(Taste).description: The ability to taste an object as it may taste in the future by choosing either one specific time period no later than 10 years per Creature Level or by tasting an object once per minute, where each consecutive taste results in what that object (or being) may taste like going forward one day at a time.

Sense Future(Touch).description: The ability to either feel the space within an area or touch an object (or being) and sense what it may feel like in the future, including any additions or removals of other shapes and objects. The creature may choose to feel a space within an area no larger than 1 cubic foot per Creature Level as it may feel like in the future by choosing either one specific time period no later than 100 years per Creature Level, or by choosing to feel any objects and textures within that area, skipping ahead in time at a rate of 1 day per minute. The creature may also choose to feel an object as it may feel in the future at a rate of 1 day per minute, until the very moment of its destruction.

Sense Past(All Senses).description: The ability to either sense the space within an area or touch an object (or being) and sense what it felt like in the past, including any additions or removals of other shapes and objects. The creature may choose to feel a space within an area no larger than 1 cubic foot per Creature Level: as it was in the past by choosing either one specific time period no earlier than 100 years per Creature Level, or by choosing to sense any objects (or beings) within that area, retreating in time at a rate of 1 day per minute. The creature may also choose to sense an object (or being) as it was in the past at a rate of 1 day per minute, until the very moment of its creation.

Sense Past(Hearing).description: The ability to use all their senses to sense within an area, or coming from an object (or being), as they were in the past. The creature may choose to sense within an area no larger than 1 cubic foot per Creature Level: as it was in the past by choosing either one specific time period no earlier than 100 years per Creature Level, or by choosing to sense within that designated area at a rate of 1 day per minute. The creature may also choose to retrace an object`s (or being`s) physical journey by tracking its emitted sounds further and further back in time until the very moment of its creation.

Sense Past(Sight).description: The ability to see either an area or an object (or being) as it appeared in the past. The creature may choose to view an area no larger than 1 cubic foot per Creature Level as it appeared in the past by choosing either one specific time period no earlier than 100 years per Creature Level, or by choosing to watch that designated area retreat in time at a rate of 1 day per minute. The creature may also choose to observe an object (or being) as it appeared further and further back in time at a rate of the creature`s choosing, until the very moment of its creation.

Sense Past(Smell).description: The ability to smell either an area or object (or being) as it smelled in the past. The creature may choose to smell an area no larger than 1 cubic foot per Creature Level as it smelled in the past by choosing either one specific time period no earlier than 100 years per Creature Level, or by choosing to observe the various smells within that designated area at a rate of 1 day per minute. The creature may also choose to retrace an object`s (or being`s) physical journey by tracking its smell further and further back in time until the very moment of its creation.

Sense Past(Taste).description: The ability to taste an object (or being) as it tasted in the past by choosing either one specific time period no earlier than 10 years per Creature Level or by tasting an object (or being) once per minute, where each consecutive taste results in what that object (or being) tasted like going back one day at a time.

Sense Past(Touch).description: The ability to either feel the space within an area or touch an object (or being) and sense what it felt like in the past, including any additions or removals of other shapes and objects. The creature may choose to feel a space within an area no larger than 1 cubic foot per Creature Level as it felt like in the past by choosing either one specific time period no earlier than 100 years per Creature Level, or by choosing to feel any objects (or beings) and textures within that area, retreating in time at a rate of 1 day per minute. The creature may also choose to feel an object (or being) as it felt like in the past at a rate of 1 day per minute, until the very moment of its creation.

Sense Time Effects.description: Being can sense the magical manipulation of time anywhere on the same plane and time anomalies that create paradoxes anywhere in the multiverse.

Shadow Attack.description: Can attack a being`s shadow as if it was the body, otherwise treat as a normal attack.

Shadow Aura.description: The creature`s Aura is shadow based, meaning that Aura does not get restored from the plane of Chaos but restores at a rate of 1 per hour on the Plane of Shadow. If the creature is a spell caster with Scroll Knowledge or similar skill then their Shadow Aura is treated as their available aura for their Aura Pool. It regenerates at a rate of 1 per hour outside the Plane of Shadow and if the being is on that plane or within 1000` feet of an open portal to that plane, it regenerates at the Scroll Knowledge (or similar skill) practitioner title regeneration rate.

Shadow Force Armor.description: The creature`s shadow acts as magical force armor whether visible or not.

Shadow Form.description: This being exists primarily on the Shadow Plane, but is able to shadow shift on to the Natural Universe or use shadow adhere magical effect for attacks, spellcasting, or any other action that requires one to be in the Natural Universe. This being’s Physical Attributes, Strength, Agility, and Vitality, do not generally apply on the Natural Universe unless the being is shadow shifted in or using shadow adhere or when they are encountered on the Shadow Plane. When shadow shifted, they only have one full body area that extends into the Natural Universe although claws, teeth or other sub areas may do so with Shadow Adhere.

Shadow Healing.description: The creature can use either Aura its own Shadow Aura or a stolen shadow to heal 1 point per point of shadow aura to all wounded areas.

Shadow Control.description: The creature can use an unconverted stolen shadow (see shadow stealing) to directly control a being. though this means the shadow is in use and cannot be converted to magical (Aura) energy for spell casting or other effects. This effect takes 10 seconds but the victim’s Control Resistance is at -20% due to their own shadow being used. Also, non-detection, vanish, and other defensive skills and abilities do not block this form of control. Though beings that are immune to control are immune to this control as well. The creature can mentally contact a controlled victim with any mental contact skill or ability anywhere on the same plane as long as they possess the unconverted shadow.

Shadow Stealing.description: These creatures can steal another`s shadow as long as it is visible and the victim fails a Magic Resistance, making the victim shadowless for the remainder of the day and lose their available Aura (not the rating). This allows the creature to convert the shadow into Aura for special abilities and spell casting. The amount stolen equals the Aura rating of the victim from whom they have stolen the shadow. This ability affects up to 1 being per creature level at a time and takes 5 seconds. They can store up to 1 unconverted shadow per creature level or title for other uses like Shadow Control or Shadow Healing.

Shadow Shifting.description: These creatures cans shift readily (5 seconds) between the Natural Universe and the Shadow Plane.

Shadow Shift.description: These creatures cans shift readily (5 seconds) between the Natural Universe and the Shadow Plane.

Sharp Leaves.description: Sharpened leaves or nettles that cause damage to areas contacted.

Sharp Bark.description: Sharpened bark that causes 1-3 damage to areas contacting it.

Shocking Sting.description: A small organ in one body area allows one or more body areas to be electrified, and being`s touching or touched by the creature will suffer electrical damage. Once discharged, the charge takes 20 seconds to regenerate.

Silent Flight.description: Silent Flight(at jogging speeds or less. +20% to surprise attack).

Skeletal Body.description: The body of the creature has died and been skeletalized, but either the being still inhabits it or it has been raised as a controlled undead being. This form is kept intact only by an energy center of negative life force bound to one of its vital areas. All areas of the body are considered limbs except for the one area where the vital region is located. The creature can only be destroyed if this vital area is destroyed.

Skin(Acid).description: Contact with the creature causes acidic damage if a Magic Resistance is failed.

Skin(Chaos).description: The skin of the creature has a magical chaos effect and lowers the object strength of objects that touch it, as well as damaging flesh (but not the creature itself). This will apply to any objects which touch the creature.

Skin(Cold).description: Contact with the creature causes cold damage if a Magic Resistance is failed.

Skin(Chromatophores).description: Skin that can change color. Grants a +20% to Move Unseen, Blend and Disguise.

Skin(Electric).description: Contact with the creature causes electrical damage if a Magic Resistance is failed.

Skin(Frost).description: Contact with the creature causes cold damage if a Magic Resistance is failed.

Skin(Heat).description: Contact with the creature causes heat damage if a Magic Resistance is failed.

Skin(Malleable).description: Skin that can change shape and texture. +20% to Move Unseen, Blend and Disguise.

Skin(Poisonous).description: The creature`s skin is coated with contact venom.

Skin(Magical Poisonous).description: The creature`s skin is coated with magical contact poison.

Sleep Beam.description: A sleep ray that travels 10 feet per level of the creature. Any being struck with less than 15 Will Force must make a Control Resistance or fall asleep for 1 minute per level of the creature.

Sleep Gaze.description: When the creature gazes at a victim, the victim must make a Control Resistance fall asleep until awakened.

Sleep Touch.description: When the creature touches a victim, the victim must make a Control Resistance fall asleep until awakened.

Sleep Voice.description: When a victim hears the voice of the creature, the victim must make a Control Resistance fall asleep until awakened.

Slow Metabolism.description: The creature has a slow metabolic rate. needs 20% of normal food intake but is +10% to weight because of fat content and +1 to initiative. 0 PP cost because the downsides balance the benefit in less food consumption.

Slow Regeneration.description: Regeneration-Slow:(Limbs/non-head vitals heal at double normal healing rate. Beheading/fatal head damage causes death.)

Small Claws.description: Small Claws: Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat.

Sleepless.description: Sleepless(Does not sleep but needs periods of inactivity that match sleep periods where they are alert but sluggish taking x2 as long to act for 2-20 seconds).

Slippery Skin.description: The skin secretes an oil that makes it difficult to grapple. All opponents attempting to grapple with the creature are at -40% to all grappling saves and -4 to all other relevant grappling rolls.

Social.description: The creature can use its senses to detect the direction and distance of the nearest creature of its type.

Social Bonding.description: Creatures of the same species with this ability have a strong affinity for one another. The creature has a method to call the nearest creature or group of creature of its type by using whatever communicative ability is appropriate.

Sonic Leaves.description: Some of the plant`s leaves are stiff and can be vibrated to produce a kind a song voice.

Speak All.description: The being or creature can speak any language, even magical ones.

Speed.description: The creature is very quick and can move very fast in short bursts. The creature has -2 defensive adjustment, -2 weapon speed (applied to body attacks) and -2 initiative.

Spirit Bound.description: The creature is bound to its physical form in one or more areas by an energy center of life force. This area counts as vital, and if bound to a physical body area, the area must be vital. Destruction of this area is the only way the creature can be killed.

Spirit Conversion.description: The ability to consume spiritual energy from beings without bodies and convert it to another form of energy or endurance. Creatures or beings struck make a Magic Resistance or suffer damage.

Spit Venom.description: The creature can spit a contact venom.

Spore(Pods).description: The plant releases spores. Spores require a Poison Resistance to avoid; if failed 1d10 in lost seconds sneezing. A few (1-5%) of beings and animals will be allergic suffering weakness of -(1-2) physical attributes for 1d4 hours after exposure. Can release spores no more than once per week and most varieties do so once per season or once per lifetime of the plant.

Spores.description: The plant releases spores. Spores require a Poison Resistance to avoid; if failed 1d10 in lost seconds sneezing. A few (1-5%) of beings and animals will be allergic suffering weakness of -(1-2) physical attributes for 1d4 hours after exposure. Can release spores no more than once per week and most varieties do so once per season or once per lifetime of the plant.

Spores(Acid).description: The plant releases spores which are acid and do acid damage to living beings they contact.

Spores(Diseased).description: The plant releases spores which carry a disease. When the spores are inhaled, that victim requires a Disease Resistance to avoid contracting the disease.

Spores(Irritant).description: Causes a rash within 24 hours of contact of a fleshy beings skin. Rash lasts 3d4 days and causes 1 point of damage per day if itched. Itching must be resisted with Will Force save or some form of topical lotion.

Spores(Parasitic).description: A Disease Resistance is required or the being or animal is infected with a parasitic agent.

Spores(Poisonous).description: The plant releases a poison in spore form.

Spores(Poison).description: The plant releases a poison in spore form.

Spores(Reproductive).description: The plant releases spores. Spores require a Poison Resistance to avoid; if failed 1d10 in lost seconds sneezing. A few (1-5%) of beings and animals will be allergic suffering weakness of -(1-2) physical attributes for 1d4 hours after exposure. Can release spores no more than once per week and most varieties do so once per season or once per lifetime of the plant.

Stasis Touch.description: The creature`s touch requires the victim to make a Magic Resistance or be in a stasis field.

Stealth.description: The creature is very stealthy when moving across the ground; +50% to surprise, +20% to Surprise Attack.

Stealth Emotion.description: +10% to stealth/intrusive skills while affected by one emotion.

Sticky Eggs.description: The creature reproduces by laying eggs which are sticky and adhere to whatever brushes against them.

Sticky Mucous(Leaves).description: Causes a Strength save to remove once per 10 seconds, -5% per square foot of sticky plant material contacting the being.

Sticky Pads.description: +40% Climb (Allows climbing surfaces of more than 90 degrees).

Sticky Suction Pads.description: +40% Climb (Allows climbing surfaces of more than 90 degrees).

Sticky Surface.description: Causes a Strength save to remove once per 10 seconds, -5% per square foot of sticky plant material contacting the being.

Sticky Tongue.description: Tongue (or appendage) elongates and secretes a sticky fluid. This tongue can be extended up to 3 times the length of the creature, and will grab any object weighing less than 1 lb. per 1` of the creature and draw it back to it. The strike takes 3 seconds, and will require a Strength save to get free. The tongue has 1/10th Endurance of the creature.

Sticky/Suction Pads.description: +40% Climb (Allows climbing surfaces of more than 90 degrees).

Stone Affinity.description: Natural affinity with stone is very strong, resulting in a +10% to Stone Lore and Speak to Stone.

Stone Swimming.description: Can swim through stone up to three times per day as the spell of the same name at Aura euqal creature level x2.

Strength Conversion.description: The creature can convert 1 damage from energy (cold damage, heat damage, etc.), any one drained attribute rating (from the drain magical abihties; Drain Mental, etc.), or one cubic foot of a certain substance (stone, wood, blood, etc.) into Strength. Strength rating cannot exceed the maximum rating based on the level (or Title) of the creature (mortals maximum is 25, etc.).

Strong Changeling Form.description: Can change into another humanoid form twice per day. The form must be within 3` of height of the Changeling`s original form. Applying the racial modifiers for that race, against the Changeling`s original values changes physical attributes and Appearance accordingly. The Disguise skill allows the Changeling to assume the form of a particular individual of that race. The Mimic skill allows the Changeling to speak as a particular individual.

Strong Spit Glob(Acid).description: This attack projects an acidic spit glob from the creature that travels up to 3` per 10 Endurance of the creature with a maximum of 300`. The glob is about 2` to 4` in size and strikes 1 humanoid body region and two random adjacent ones. Range is short; up to 1/2 of the maximum range and medium for the remaining distance. The attack chart is used to hit. This attack can be utilized 3 times per hour.

Strong Spit Glob(Fire).description: This attack projects a fiery spit glob from the creature that travels up to 3` per 10 Endurance of the creature with a maximum of 300`. The glob is about 2` to 4` in size and strikes 1 humanoid body region and two random adjacent ones. Range is short; up to 1/2 of the maximum range and medium for the remaining distance. The attack chart is used to hit. This attack can be utilized 3 times per hour.

Strength.description: Has an increased Strength for a creature of it`s type.

Stubborn.description: +20% to Control Resistance, allowing a Control Resistance in situations when animals normally do not receive one. The creature may also may balk if tired, underfed or in harsh conditions (-20% to Animal Training, Riding or Horsemanship).

Substance Sense.description: The ability to sense the proximity of specific substance through the extension of an existing sense, i.e. sniff gold only. Such senses are listed as: Gold Sense, Steel Sense, Water Sense, etc.

Suction Pads.description: +40% Climb (Allows climbing surfaces of more than 90 degrees).

Sunlight Resistant.description: Beings transmuted permanently to (usually to stone) by sunlight are now only transmuted when the sun strikes them, returning to normal form when emmersed completely in darkness.

Superior Regeneration.description: Regeneration-Superior:(Regenerates 1d6 points to all wounds per 10 sec. Limbs regenerate and are restored when fully healed. Vital area loss causes death.)

Supernatural Agility.description: The creature can choose a Agility rating above what its body type allows (medium large, etc.), max. of +8.

Supernatural Control Resistance.description: The creature is supernaturally resistant to control.

Supernatural Damage Bonus.description: The being or creature adds a damage bonus (maximum of +50) to all melee attacks that hit.

Supernatural Defensive Modifier.description: The being or creature subtracts up to -10 from the chance their defensive modifier.

Supernatural Disease Resistance.description: The creature is supernaturally resistant to disease.

Supernatural Endurance.description: The creature has an invisible magic hide which acts like the spell Force Armor.

Supernatural Hide.description: The creature has a greater Endurance than a creature of its type and size.

Supernatural Illusion Resistance.description: The creature is supernaturally resistant to illusions.

Supernatural Load Limit.description: The being or creature increases their load limit by up to 200%.

Supernatural Magic Resistance.description: The creature is supernaturally magically resistant.

Supernatural Poison Resistance.description: The creature is supernaturally resistant to poison.

Supernatural Speed.description: The creature gains an additional 1d4 seconds in a combat round.

Supernatural Strength.description: The creature can choose a Strength rating above what its body type allows (medium large, etc.), max. of +8.

Supernatural Vitality.description: The creature can choose a Vitality rating above what its body type allows (medium large, etc.), max. of +8.

Supernatural Weapon Speed.description: The being or creature lowers their weapon speed by up to -10 to all weapon attacks.

Swim Bladder.description: An air bladder that is not used for breathing but allows an aquatic animal to maintain neutral buoyancy in water.

Swim Bladder(Magical).description: An air bladder that is not used for breathing but allows an aquatic animal to maintain neutral buoyancy in water and can be filled and refilled quickly by internal magical means. Air is also magically condensed as needed allowing for unusually high amounts of air when needed.

Swimming.description: Swimming(+50% to Swimming skill, swim movement at x3 walking).

Symbiosis.description: This creature can bond with another creature or being as per the spell of the same name.

Tail.description: Gains a tail, 1/2x Endurance body area.

Tail(Barbed).description: The creature has a tail which ends in a spike that is barbed. The barb may break off and lodge itself in the wound.

Tail(Large).description: Gains a tail, 1x Endurance body area.

Tail Slap.description: Tail Slap: Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat.

Talons.description: Talons: Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat.

Talons/Large Claws.description: Talons/Large Claws: Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat.

Teeth.description: Rending Teeth:(Gains additional attacks in combat).

Tentacles.description: Tentacles(Act as extra hands but without the ability to delicately manipulate objects.)

Terrain Blending.description: Terrain Blending(+20% to Surprise Attack/Blend in native terrain).

Terrain Fur.description: Terrain Fur(+20% to Blend/Move Unseen in native terrain).

Thick Roots.description: +20% to the Brace skill, as well as any saves or contests involving Agility or Strength against being moved or toppled.

Thought Sense.description: Sense all minds in 3` per Will Force

Thorns.description: Does damage to all areas that contact the thorny surface.

Thorns(Barbed).description: Does damage to all areas that contact the thorny surface (+1 per die). 1d6+2 thorns break off in the flesh of the victim and do 1 point of damage each when removed.

Thorns(Diseased).description: The plant thorns carries a disease. When the thorns make an appropriate form of contact with a victim, that victim requires a Disease Resistance to avoid contracting the disease.

Thorns(Irritant).description: Causes a rash within 24 hours of contact of a fleshy beings skin. Rash lasts 3d4 days and causes 1 point of damage per day if itched. Itching must be resisted with Will Force save or some form of topical lotion.

Thorns(Parasitic).description: A Disease Resistance is required or the being or animal is infected with a parasitic agent.

Thorns(Poisonous).description: Poison(secretes or releases a poison on its thorns).

Thorns(Small).description: Does damage to all areas that contact the thorny surface.

Thorns(Venomous).description: Venom(secretes or releases a venom on its thorns).

Time Displacing Touch.description: The victim must make a Magic Resistance or be cast forward in time 1d4+1 seconds, minutes, hours, days or weeks. The time period type is chosen by the creature.

Time Repulsion.description: A random number of targets within a set range (10 to 30 feet) must make a Magic Resistance or be flung forward in time 2-20 seconds. Roll separately for each.

Time Split.description: The creature exists in three time periods at once; now, 1-3 seconds in the past, 1-3 seconds in the future. All three are visible but two are time shadows of the past/and future. No harm can come to the creature unless the same type of attack occurs to all three parts at the same time. For example, to damage the creature with a physical attack, then the same type of weapon would need to hit the past part 1-3 seconds in the past, and the future part 1-3 seconds in the future even as it is being hit in the same place in the present. This is very hard to pull off without careful observation and timing. Half intelligence save per 10 seconds of observation to understand that the being is split into three parts and only if trying intently.

Touch(Acid).description: A body area or contact point secretes acid, causing damage through armor (magic armor gets a save).

Touch(Acidic).description: A body area or contact point secretes acid, causing damage through armor (magic armor gets a save).

Touch(Aura).description: A touch of chaotic powers. Requires those touched to make a Magic Resistance or take direct aura damage

Touch(Chaos).description: When a living creature touches a victim, the victim must make a Magic Resistance or suffer 1 chaos effect as they sleep that next night (as the disease Touch of Chaos).

Touch(Chaos:Lesser).description: When a living creature touches a victim, the victim must make a Disease Resistance or be stricken with the Touch of Chaos disease (roll for severity, duration, etc., See Touch of Chaos).

Touch(Chaos:Greater).description: When a living creature touches a victim, the victim must make a Magic Resistance or immediately suffer 1 chaos effect (as the disease Touch of Chaos) but the change occurs in 1d10 seconds.

Touch(Chill).description: A body area or contact point steals heat from other beings, causing damage through armor (magic armor gets a save).

Touch(Control).description: When the creature touches a victim, the victim must make a Control Resistance or fall under the effects of the spell Control Humanoid as long as the victim is within sight of the creature.

Touch(Disintegration).description: Touch causes living creatures to make a Magic Resistance or be disintegrated.

Touch(Death).description: When a living creature is touched, the victim must make a Magic Resistance or die in 1d10 seconds.

Touch(Death:Lesser).description: When a living creature is touched, the victim must make a Magic Resistance or suffer a heart attack: 6d6 damage to the upper torso. No actions may be taken for 1d4 minutes. The victim must make a Vitality save or lose 1 Vitality rating permanently.

Touch(Death:Greater).description: When a living creature is touched, the victim must make a Magic Resistance at -20% or die instantly. The victim must make a Vitality save at -20% or lose 1 Vitality rating permanently.

Touch(Disease:Magical).description: When the creature touches a victim, the victim must make a Disease Resistance at -10% or suffer a random disease which is always the worst possible form of that disease. It lasts for the longest period possible and the effects begin in 1d4x1 minutes.

Touch(Disease:Greater).description: When the creature touches a victim, the victim must make a Disease Resistance at -20% or suffer a random disease which is always the worst possible form of that disease. It lasts for the longest period possible and the effects begin in 1d4x10 seconds.

Touch(Drain).description: As Mystical Drain. The ability to drain Will Force (or other mystical attribute) temporarily adding that to their own rating or for use in healing conversion, etc. Requires Touch. Can be substituted for another drain: Mental, Physical, Personal.

Touch(Dream).description: The physical touch (or attack) of the creature causes the target to make a Control Resistance or fall into a sleep state for 1-3 hours. If on the Dream Plane this instead sends those who are not Dreamers (those with the Dream Shift skill) back to their home planes. Beings who have physically traveled to the Dream Plane are not sent home, sleeping instead (a dream within a dream.)

Touch(Electrical).description: A body area or contact point discharges electricity, causing damage through armor (magic armor gets a save).

Touch(Electric).description: A body area or contact point discharges electricity, causing damage through armor (magic armor gets a save).

Touch(Euphoric).description: A half Will Force Save is required to take harmful action against the source of the touch.

Touch(Fatigue:Mental).description: The creature`s touch causes the victim to make an intelligence save at -50% or drop 1 level of mental fatigue. When the victim reaches the highest level of mental fatigue, she begins making an intelligence save at -50% every minute or fall unconscious. If she is also at the highest level of physical fatigue, she begins to die and must make additional -50% Vitality saves every minute. When three such saves fail the victim dies.

Touch(Fatigue:Physical).description: The creature`s touch causes the victim to make a Vitality save at -50% or lose 1 level of physical fatigue. When the victim reaches the highest level of physical fatigue, he begins making a Vitality save at -50% every minute or be unable to move. If he is also at the highest level of mental fatigue, he begins to die and must make additional -50% Vitality saves every minute. When three such saves fail the victim dies.

Touch(Frost).description: A body area or contact point steals heat from other beings, causing damage through armor (magic armor gets a save).

Touch(Ghostly).description: Touch does magical cold damage if the victim`s Magic Resistance fails and drains Will Force if a Control Resistance fails.

Touch(Heat).description: A body area or contact point generates flashes of heat, causing damage through armor (magic armor gets a save).

Touch(Insanity).description: When the creature touches a victim, the victim must make a Will Force save or suffer a type of insanity.

Touch(Light).description: This creature has a focused magical light emission that requires touch to damage. Those touched require a successful Magic Resistance or damage is taken. Also lights an area brightly in a 10-foot radius per level (or Title) of the creature and casts a dim light at a radius up to 3x level.

Touch(Mind Wipe).description: Touch causes the victim to make a Control Resistance or forget about the being or creature.

Touch(Negative Life).description: The creature has a negative life force. Touch of living things causes a Magic Resistance or negative life force damage is done to the area.

Touch(Paralysis).description: When the creature touches a victim, the victim must make a Control Resistance or fall under the effects of the spell Paralysis as long as the victim is within sight of the creature.

Touch(Sleep).description: When the creature touches a victim, the victim must make a Control Resistance fall asleep until awakened.

Touch(Sonic).description: The creature`s touch is a vibrating magical sonic attack that requires a successful Magic Resistance or damage is done to the area touched.

Touch(Stasis).description: The creature`s touch requires the victim to make a Magic Resistance or be in a stasis field.

Touch(Transforming).description: When the creature touches a victim, the victim must make a Magic Resistance or be transmuted to Crystal, Flesh, Metal, Stone, or Wood.

Touch(Time Displacement).description: The victim must make a Magic Resistance or be cast forward in time 1d4+1 seconds, minutes, hours, days or weeks. The time period type is chosen by the creature.

Touch(Withering).description: Once per 10 seconds, victim permanently loses 1d4 Endurance in the area struck, 1 permanent Will Force, and permanently ages 1/20 of their life span, unless a Magic Resistance is made for the Endurance damage and a Control Resistance to avoid the Will Force lost and aging.

Transfixing Gaze.description: When the creature gazes at a victim, the victim must make a Control Resistance or remain motionless until disturbed or shaken.

Transfixing Touch.description: When the creature touches a victim, the victim must make a Control Resistance or remain motionless until disturbed or shaken.

Transfixing Voice.description: When a victim hears the voice of the creature, the victim must make a Control Resistance or remain motionless until disturbed or shaken.

Transformation Attack.description: Transforms a limb or attacking projectile inside the target`s body. The target makes a Magic Resistance if struck. Failure indicates 1d10 to 10d10 damage as the object transforms inside of them.

Transformation Drain.description: Added to any attribute drain ability, but if the victim`s attribute goes below zero, the victim is transformed into a creature of similar type.

Transform(Fish Tail).description: Transform(Fish Tail):(transform lower body, lower torso down into a fish tail: x3 Endurance tail and a x1 Endurance fin).

Translucent.description: +20% to Surprise Attack, Move Unseen. Is -2 to be hit, (-4 in water.)

Transmuting Gaze.description: When the creature gazes at a victim, the victim must make a Magic Resistance or be transmuted to Crystal, Flesh, Metal, Stone, or Wood.

Transmuting Self.description: The creature can transmute itself to Crystal, Flesh, Metal, Stone, or Wood and back again.

Transmuting Touch.description: When the creature touches a victim, the victim must make a Magic Resistance or be transmuted to Crystal, Flesh, Metal, Stone, or Wood.

Transmuting Voice.description: When a victim hears the voice of the creature, the victim must make a Magic Resistance or be transmuted to Crystal, Flesh, Metal, Stone, or Wood.

Treasure Finding(Gems).description: Treasure Sniffing(The sense of Smell can be used to find gems and jewelry).

Treasure Sniffing.description: Treasure Sniffing(The sense of Smell can be used to find valuables).

Treasure Sniffing(Crafted).description: Treasure Sniffing(The sense of Smell can be used to find finely crafted goods).

Treasure Sniffing(Gems/Jewelry).description: Treasure Sniffing(The sense of Smell can be used to find gems and jewelry).

Truesight.description: This being automatically sees through all illusions, invisibility, and other forms of concealment.

Trunk.description: Prehensile Tail/Trunk(Acts as a third hand but without the ability to delicately manipulate objects. The tail/trunk has x1 Endurance and adds +20% to Climb.)

Ultra Regeneration.description: Regeneration-Ultra:(Regenerates 1 point to all wounds per second unless acid damaged. Limbs regenerate and are restored when fully healed. Head or upper torso loss still cause death (brain/heart).

Ultravision.description: Ultravision(Vision in ultraviolet spectrum. Can see in darkness).

Undead Affinity.description: Has a strong desire to be around undead and gains the skill Coexist with Undead at +30%.

Undead Body.description: The body of the creature has died, but the being still inhabits it. This form is kept intact only by an energy center of negative life force bound to one of its vital areas. All areas of the body are considered limbs, except the one area where the vital region is located. The creature can only be destroyed if the this vital area is destroyed. Additionaly, all non-vital areas can go between 0 Endurance and negative the creature`s Vitality rating without having to make a Vitality save to retain use of the body area. The body will eventually decay to skeletal form unless some form of attribute drain is combined with a conversion drain into Endurance.

Undetectable.description: Creature cannot be detected except by the spell Detect Protection.

Underwater Vision.description: Underwater Vision(No penalties or distance modifiers when seeing in clear water).

Venom Blood.description: The blood of the creature is poisonous, and any being which touches the blood must make poison resistance or suffer the effects of the poison type.

Venom Hallucinogen.description: A poison that causes hallucinations of whatever the being desires or imagines.

Venom Sleep.description: Failure indicates victim falls immediately asleep.

Venom(Blinding).description: Venom:This type of poison blinds if the victim`s resistance fails, and may be of any potency.

Venom(Illusionary Odor).description: Venom:A contact liquid that requires a Poison Resistance or the illusion of the worst smell possible is then emitted from the sticky poison. The victim is -50% to Move Unseen/Blend. Lasts up to one day or until removed by alcohol or magical cleaning.

Venom(Nightmare).description: Venom:Requires a Poison Resistance or instantly and for the remainder of the victim’s stay on the Dream Plane they will see their fears manifest in sound, smell, and sight. Initially and under any stressful situations, they must make two Will Force saving throws. The first save is to avoid insanity. The insanity type is neurosis, specifically a phobia of their strongest fear. The second save is to avoid fleeing the source of their fear in illusionary (or real) form. All of these effects are removed when the victim leaves the dreamscape.

Venom(Nightmare Poison).description: Venom:Requires a Poison Resistance or instantly and for the remainder of the victim’s stay on the Dream Plane they will see their fears manifest in sound, smell, and sight. Initially and under any stressful situations, they must make two Will Force saving throws. The first save is to avoid insanity. The insanity type is neurosis, specifically a phobia of their strongest fear. The second save is to avoid fleeing the source of their fear in illusionary (or real) form. All of these effects are removed when the victim leaves the dreamscape.

Venom(Sleep).description: Failure indicates victim falls immediately asleep.

Venom(Strong).description: Venom(Strong):(Poison Type = Title x2, Potency J).

Venomous Bark.description: Venom(secretes or releases a poison on its bark).

Venomous Fangs.description: Fangs:(Gains additional natural weapon attacks in combat that inject or release a poison).

Venomous Leaves.description: Venom(secretes or releases a poison on its leaves).

Venomous Thorns.description: Venom(secretes or releases a poison on its thorns).

Very High Metabolism.description: +20% food intake requirements, weight is -20%, -3 to initiative.

Very High Pain Threshold.description: The creature takes 2 less point of physical damage per blow from weapons or energy attacks.

Very High Tolerance For Pain.description: The creature takes 2 less point of physical damage per blow from weapons or energy attacks.

Very Slow Metabolism.description: -50% food intake requirements, respiration is slowed, movement is 50%, weight is +20%, +2 to initiative.

Vibration Language.description: Vibration Language(Can speak in a language of Vibrations that can be learned by anyone who has Vibration Sensing).

Vibration Sensing.description: Vibration Sensing(sense subtle vibrations, generally within 1000`).

Vibration Sense.description: Vibration Sensing(sense subtle vibrations, generally within 1000`).

Vitality.description: Has an increased Vitality for a creature of it`s type.

Voice(Chaos).description: When the creature laughs or speaks for 5 seconds all who hear must make a Magic Resistance or mistake friend for foe. This lasts 10-30 seconds. Also, each action made while the being laughs or speaks requires an Intelligence Save or the action is at -10%/-2 because of confusion.

Voice(Chaos:Lesser).description: When the creature laughs or speaks for 5 seconds all who hear must make an Intelligence Save or mistake friend for foe for the next action.

Voice(Chaos:Greater).description: When the creature laughs or speaks for 5 seconds all who hear must make a Magic Resistance at -20% or mistake friend for foe. This lasts 1d4 minutes. Also, each action made while the being laughs or speaks requires an Intelligence Save or the action is at -20%/-4 because of confusion.

Voice(Futile).description: When the creature speaks or laughs all beings that hear must make a Control Resistance for each action taken otherwise do nothing for 1d4+1 seconds.

Voice(Futile:Greater).description: When the creature speaks or laughs all beings that hear must make a Control Resistance at -20% or fall into despair and take no action unless they are attacked or shaken by an ally (gives a new -20% magic resistance each time).

Voice(Control).description: When a victim hears the voice of the creature, the victim must make a Control Resistance or fall under the effects of the spell Control Humanoid as long as the victim can hear the voice.

Voice(Insanity).description: When a victim hears the voice of the creature, the victim must make a Will Force save or suffer a type of insanity.

Voice(Transfixing).description: When a victim hears the voice of the creature, the victim must make a Control Resistance or remain motionless until disturbed or shaken.

Voice(Transmuting).description: When a victim hears the voice of the creature, the victim must make a Magic Resistance or be transmuted to Crystal, Flesh, Metal, Stone, or Wood.

Voice(Sleep).description: When a victim hears the voice of the creature, the victim must make a Control Resistance fall asleep until awakened.

Voidwalk.description: The creature`s locomotion limbs can be placed against any surface, in midair, or even anywhere in a void. If there is a surface then the being is adhered. If no surface exists, the ability produces a temporary crystal surface an inch or so around the foot (or similar appendage). The surface is fixed in place so the being can walk or stand on it. Every time the limb is lifted up, the generated surface vanishes. A new surface is created each time the limb comes down.

Warrior Claws.description: Claws otherwise used for digging are replaced with serrated, blade-like claws, useable as cutting weapons.

Water Affinity.description: Natural affinity with water is very strong, resulting in a +10% to Water Lore and Animal Shape when transforming into a waterbased creature (such as a fish).

Water Bladder.description: The creature has a magical organ which produces needed water. They do not require an external source of water. They cannot die of thirst so long as the organ functions.

Water Elemental Form.description: Water Elemental Form(Creature can transform into an Water Elemental. With all powers and abilities at a level equal to Class Title x2. Requires a source of water.)

Water Sac.description: The creature has a water sac which stores extra water. This will increase the duration the creature can go without water for up to one month.

Weak Acid.description: Secretes a very weak acid used to dissolve dead biological materal.

Web Weaving.description: Web Weaving(Strong webs are web strength of creature`s END and Hide equal to the creature`s VIT. Sticky webs are 1/2 END but cause entanglement: STR Save at -50% to escape. Both types shoot to dagger range).

Web Weaving(Sticky).description: Web Weaving(Sticky webs are 1/2 END but cause entanglement: STR Save at -50% to escape. Shoot to dagger range.

Web Weaving(Strong).description: Web Weaving(Strong webs are web strength of creature`s END and Hide equal to the creature`s VIT. Shoot to dagger range.

Well Tanned Skin.description: Damage from exposure to the sun is removed.

Will Force.description: Has an increased Will Force for a creature of it`s type.

Will Force Collector(Living).description: Will Force gathers to the being (must have a Will Force Reservoir) at a rate of 1 per week.

Will Force Collector(Death).description: Will Force gathers to the being (must have a Will Force Reservoir) at a rate of 1 per being that is killed in their presence, 2 Will Force if they kill that being themselves.

Will Force Container.description: The creature has separate reservoir for Will Force, which can be used to hold Will Force points taken from other beings or items. This extra Will Force will count towards the beings Will Force rating for purposes of skills and saves, but it cannot be used for a skill, spell or invocation which requires Will Force to make something permanent.

Wing Projection.description: Wing Projection(Magical Flight. Projects a mental image of wings during flight).

Wings.description: Wings(Natural Flight at x3 walking speed. Wings give the creature the ability to fly).

Wisdom.description: Has an increased Wisdom for a creature of it`s type.

Withering Touch.description: Once per 10 seconds, victim permanently loses 1d4 Endurance in the area struck, 1 permanent Will Force, and permanently ages 1/20 of their life span, unless a Magic Resistance is made for the Endurance damage and a Control Resistance to avoid the Will Force lost and aging.

Wood Cutting.description: The creature has sharp teeth, claws or pinchers designed for the cutting of wood. If used to attack, damage counts as a normal bite or punch attack.
